About Big Bus Tours
-------------------

Big Bus Tours is the world’s largest operator of open-top sightseeing tours, fueling the spirit of adventure in 23 world-famous cities across four continents. Beginning its journey 28 years ago, with a fleet of only three buses, Big Bus Tours has swiftly expanded to a global fleet of hundreds of open-top buses, turning 6 million tourists into explorers, every year. Big Bus Tours operates in Los Angeles, Singapore, Dublin, London, Dubai, Hong Kong, New York, Las Vegas, Chicago, Abu Dhabi, Budapest, Istanbul, Miami, Muscat, Rome, Paris, Philadelphia, San Francisco, Darwin, Sydney, Vienna, Berlin and Washington DC, with a sightseeing concept designed to provide a flexible approach to city discovery. Each open-top bus tour provides a hop-on, hop-off facility at a variety of interesting locations, with complimentary additions to enhance the visitor sightseeing experience. In February 2015, private equity firm Exponent purchased Big Bus Tours, with a shared vision to make Big Bus Tours the number 1 thing to do in each world-famous city. In 2016, Merlin Entertainments PLC became a shareholder, offering a natural synergy with Big Bus Tours and Merlin attractions and experiences around the world. With entertaining guides and commentary and knowledge of the latest events in each city, the Big Bus City Crew leaves every passenger with a story to tell. A perfect city companion, The Big Bus Tours app includes tour highlights, city guides and map and real-time bus tracking, downloadable in the Apple and Android App stores. Every issue of BookPage offers 32 pages of book reviews, author interviews and special features, focusing on all types of books, from literary fiction, history and biography to popular genres like romance and mystery. Articles are upbeat yet informative, literary yet accessible, as BookPage strives to connect every type of reader with a book they’ll love—even kids and teens.  
  
BookPage is a valuable tool for your library and for every book lover.

About Richard Dreyfuss

Richard Dreyfuss is an iconic American actor who has left an indelible mark on the film industry. With his distinctive voice, expressive face, and unparalleled talent, Dreyfuss has captivated audiences for over five decades. Known for his versatility and ability to seamlessly transition between genres, he has portrayed a wide range of characters, showcasing his immense acting prowess.  
  
Born on October 29, 1947, in Brooklyn, New York, Dreyfuss discovered his passion for acting at a young age. He attended Beverly Hills High School, where he honed his skills and appeared in various school productions. Dreyfuss continued his education at San Fernando Valley State College (now California State University, Northridge), but his true calling resided in the world of the performing arts.  
  
Dreyfuss made his professional acting debut in 1964 with a small role in the play "The Highest Tree." This marked the beginning of a long and illustrious career that would see him gracing both the stage and the silver screen. He gained critical acclaim and recognition for his breakout performance as Baby Face Nelson in the 1973 crime film "Dillinger." Dreyfuss effortlessly embodied the ruthless and unpredictable nature of the infamous gangster, leaving audiences in awe of his acting prowess.  
  
However, it was Dreyfuss's role as the ambitious music student, Richard Dreyfuss as "Baby Face" Nelson in the 1973 hit film "The Sting" that catapulted him to stardom. His memorable portrayal garnered him widespread acclaim and earned him an Academy Award nomination for Best Supporting Actor. This nomination marked the first of many accolades to come.  
  
In 1975, Dreyfuss etched himself into cinematic history with his unforgettable performance as Roy Neary in Steven Spielberg's science-fiction masterpiece, "Close Encounters of the Third Kind." Dreyfuss's portrayal of an ordinary man caught up in a supernatural encounter struck a chord with audiences, earning him critical acclaim and a nomination for the Academy Award for Best Actor. His ability to convey a wide range of emotions throughout the film solidified his status as one of the most talented actors of his generation.  
  
Dreyfuss continued to deliver captivating performances in a variety of films, showcasing his versatility as an actor. In 1978, he starred in the musical drama "The Goodbye Girl," earning him an Academy Award for Best Actor. His portrayal of Elliott Garfield, a struggling actor, showcased his comedic timing and ability to bring charm and vulnerability to the screen.  
  
Throughout the 1980s and 1990s, Dreyfuss appeared in numerous successful films, including the comedy classic "Down and Out in Beverly Hills" (1986), the heartwarming drama "Mr. Holland's Opus" (1995), and the political drama "The American President" (1995). His ability to seamlessly transition between comedic and dramatic roles solidified his place as one of Hollywood's most talented actors.  
  
In addition to his success on the big screen, Dreyfuss has also made his mark on the stage. He has appeared in several highly acclaimed theatrical productions, including "The Producers," "Death and the Maiden," and "Sly Fox." Dreyfuss's performances on stage have garnered him Tony Award nominations, further cementing his status as a versatile actor capable of conquering any medium.  
  
Beyond his acting career, Dreyfuss has dedicated himself to advocating for civics education. In 2005, he formed The Dreyfuss Initiative, a non-profit organization aimed at promoting the importance of teaching civics in schools across the United States. Dreyfuss firmly believes that an engaged and educated citizenry is essential for a thriving democracy.  
  
Richard Dreyfuss's talent, passion, and commitment to his craft have made him an indomitable force in the entertainment industry. From his breakout role as Baby Face Nelson to his iconic portrayal in "Close Encounters of the Third Kind," he has consistently delivered captivating performances that have resonated with audiences worldwide. About Bryan Leung

Bryan Leung is a Senior Machine Learning Engineer at Spotify, where he leverages over a decade of experience in machine learning, data science, and software development to drive innovation in audio content delivery. With a PhD in machine learning, Bryan specializes in the end-to-end development of scalable systems that integrate advanced algorithms, including deep learning, reinforcement learning, and multi-arm bandit techniques. His current focus is on enhancing user experience through personalized recommendations, particularly through groundbreaking projects like the AI DJ. In this project, Bryan developed a sophisticated bandit sampling model that not only efficiently explores new content but also mitigates ranking position bias in neural network outputs, ensuring that users receive diverse and relevant music suggestions.  
  
Bryan's expertise extends to various domains, including micromobility, marketing, and advertising, where he has successfully built machine learning products that have significantly impacted business outcomes. His quantitative skills are complemented by a strong foundation in big data technologies and statistical modeling, making him adept at handling complex datasets and deriving actionable insights. As a mentor, Bryan is passionate about fostering the next generation of engineers, guiding interns and junior team members through the intricacies of machine learning projects. His effective communication skills enable him to present complex concepts clearly, ensuring that both technical and non-technical stakeholders understand the value of machine learning initiatives. At Spotify, Bryan continues to push the boundaries of what is possible in audio technology, driving the company’s mission to connect listeners with the music they love in innovative ways.

The organization focuses on creating impactful programs that address the unique challenges faced by young people in various communities, both locally and globally.  
  
At the core of Youthreach International's offerings are its comprehensive services designed to support nonprofits in maximizing their outreach and effectiveness. These services include program development, strategic planning, fundraising support, and capacity building. By leveraging innovative technologies and best practices in nonprofit management, Youthreach International equips organizations with the tools they need to thrive in an ever-evolving landscape.  
  
The organization also emphasizes collaboration and partnerships, working closely with local stakeholders to ensure that their initiatives are culturally relevant and sustainable. By utilizing data-driven approaches and community engagement strategies, Youthreach International not only enhances the impact of its programs but also fosters a sense of ownership among the youth it serves.  
  
Through its commitment to empowering the next generation, Youthreach International is making significant strides in creating a brighter future for young people. The Federal University of Rio Grande do Sul (UFRGS), headquartered in Porto Alegre, Brazil, stands as a prestigious institution with over a century of academic excellence. Recognized both nationally and internationally, UFRGS offers a comprehensive range of courses across all fields of knowledge, catering to students from elementary education through to postgraduate studies. The university prides itself on its highly qualified faculty, predominantly composed of master's and doctoral degree holders, ensuring a robust educational experience.  
  
UFRGS continuously invests in modernizing its infrastructure, including state-of-the-art laboratories and extensive libraries, which support its commitment to high-quality teaching and research. With approximately 40,000 individuals traversing its campus daily, the university is a vibrant hub of academic activity. The institution's dedication to research is evident in its recognized levels of excellence, while its extension programs actively engage the community, providing diverse activities that foster social responsibility and knowledge dissemination.  
  
As a public university dedicated to societal service, UFRGS emphasizes critical thinking, inclusivity, and experimentation, all while upholding the ideals of freedom and solidarity. This commitment not only enhances the educational landscape but also reinforces its role as a leader in producing knowledge. [Harrison Butker Email & Phone Number](https://contactout.com/harrison-butker-email-61691 "Harrison Butker Email & Phone Number")

==================================================================================================================================

Football kicker | Decatur, GA

View Harrison Butker Email & Phone Number
-----------------------------------------

About Harrison Butker

Harrison Butker is a prominent football kicker known for his precision, powerful leg, and clutch performances. Born on July 14, 1995, in Decatur, Georgia, Butker's journey from a talented high school athlete to a successful NFL player is nothing short of remarkable.  
  
From an early age, Butker exhibited a unique talent for kicking footballs. He played high school football at Westminster School in Atlanta, where his skill and dedication quickly set him apart from his peers. Butker's impressive accuracy and consistent power caught the attention of college recruiters, leading him to accept a scholarship offer from Georgia Tech.  
  
During his time at Georgia Tech, Butker continued to impress with his phenomenal performances. He showcased his skills by consistently kicking field goals from varying distances, becoming a vital asset to the team's success. Butker's lethal accuracy and composure under pressure earned him a reputation as one of the most reliable kickers in college football.  
  
In his senior year, Butker's impact on the Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets was undeniable. He displayed remarkable consistency, finishing the season with a career-high 15 consecutive field goals made. Butker's crucial contribution to the team's victories earned him numerous accolades, including being named a finalist for the Lou Groza Award, given to the nation's top college kicker.  
  
Butker's exceptional college career garnered the attention of NFL scouts, leading to him being selected by the Carolina Panthers in the seventh round of the 2017 NFL Draft. Despite being a late-round pick, Butker's talent became evident during his first NFL season. He was initially perceived as a temporary replacement for an injured kicker but quickly proved himself as a valuable asset to the team.  
  
In his rookie season with the Panthers, Butker's accuracy was impeccable, converting 29 out of 30 extra point attempts and 17 out of 18 field goal attempts. However, due to the presence of the experienced Graham Gano, Butker was released just before the start of the 2017 regular season and was subsequently claimed off waivers by the Kansas City Chiefs.  
  
Butker's arrival in Kansas City became a turning point in his career. In his first game as a Chief, he made an immediate impact by kicking five field goals, including a 43-yard game-winning kick in overtime. This remarkable debut laid the foundation for what would become a dominant and consistent career in Kansas City.  
  
Since joining the Chiefs, Butker has continued to excel, becoming one of the league's premier kickers. With a combination of accuracy, range, and consistency, Butker's leg has become a valuable weapon for the Chiefs' high-octane offense. He consistently delivers clutch performances, securing crucial points for the team and often exceeding expectations.  
  
One of Butker's most notable moments came during the 2019 NFL season. In the AFC Championship Game against the New England Patriots, he made all three of his field goal attempts, including a clutch 39-yard field goal to send the game to overtime. Ultimately, the Chiefs won the game, securing a spot in Super Bowl LIV. Butker's ability to perform under immense pressure and deliver in important moments showcases his mental fortitude and dedication to his craft.  
  
In addition to his accuracy and clutch performances, Butker's leg strength is a true marvel. About Baré Alchemy
------------------

Jeanne Baré broke all the rules. She came from humble beginnings and ended up becoming the first woman ever to circumnavigate the globe. Women in the eighteenth century were forbidden to travel on expeditions, so she decided to dress up as a man and get herself aboard! A Master Botanist, not only did she teach herself to identify plants to treat wounds and diseases, but she probably discovered the “Bougainville”, a dazzling vine found in Brazil at the time. Her’s is a story of bravery, passion, adventure and travels through uncertain environments, many miles away from home; a far cry from the gentle pastimes afforded to the fairer sex of her times!  
  
Baré Alchemy has explored Australia and the traditional healing remedies of the native Aboriginals for 50,000 years to carefully craft it in the Ambrosia Serums. Made with love, Baré Alchemy creates limited batches of bespoke natural skin serums. Using advanced bio-chemistry and molecular biology, while still being deeply rooted in ancient knowledge, our Ambrosia serums contain precious Australian botanicals such as the Kakadu Plum, the source of the highest content of natural vitamin C antioxidant on the planet, that provide essential nutrients and moisture at the cellular level of your skin.  
  
We celebrate the unparalleled spirit for adventure and salute the courage to charter your own personal journey, to explore who you really are, what you believe in, and where you want to go.

About INDUS MOTORS CO. (P) LTD
------------------------------

Indus Motor Company Private Limited, (trade name, Indus Motors) is the top ranking Maruti Dealer in India. The Company having its registered office at Indus House, Chakorathukulam, Calicut and Corporate Office at Thevara, Kochi was incorporated on 11th July, 1984.  
The founders of the company were prominent NRI’s Dr. P A Ibrahim Haji &Mr TM Nair.  
  
Mr T M Nair arrived in Dubai in 1959 and later he reached out to the well-known company Nissan in Japan and secured the agency representation of Datsun cars in UAE foreseeing the boom in oil industry. It was the first time that Japanese cars were introduced in the Middle East. Since then he popularly had known as ‘Datsun Nair’  
.  
As the association with Japanese authorities was progressing in the 80s, he became aware that the automobile giant Suzuki was in talks with Sanjay Gandhi for a collaboration of a new low-cost Indo-Japanese model. Mr Nair was very excited with the prospect and knew well how the success in the GCC model could easily repeat itself in India. Hence he mooted the idea of launching an automobile company in India. He founded Indus Motor Company in Calicut, Kerala, partnering with his long-time friend Haji PA Ibrahim.  
  
Dr P A Ibrahim Haji started his entrepreneurial journey in the UAE in 1974 with his own garments business before branching out into cosmetics. In 1976, he expanded it to the trading business, starting Century Trading Company and later into jewellery business.  
  
Dr. P . A. Ibrahim Haji again broadened his horizon of achievements further to education field in 1999 by setting up the PACE Education Group. He was also founder and vice-chairman of the Indus Motor Company.  
  
In the year 1993 Mr P V Abdul Wahab (Rajya Sabha MP) was taken over as the Director and a shareholder. Management was later taken over by Mr P V Abdul Wahab in the year 1998.  
  
Now Indus Motors literally reigns as the most sought after Maruti dealer in India with significant and competitive track records and achievements.

About Catholic Crosscultural Services
-------------------------------------

Catholic Crosscultural Services (CCS) is a GTA-based, national non-profit organization, providing programs and services to empower newcomers, immigrants and refugees to settle, integrate and prosper in Canada.  
  
From its humble beginnings in a downtown Toronto church in 1954, CCS has grown into one of the largest settlement organizations in Canada. More than 200 employees and 100’s of volunteers deliver culturally-sensitive and linguistically appropriate programs and services in more than thirty languages.  
  
We serve all newcomers -- regardless of race, religion, age, country of origin, sexual orientation, immigration status, or political affiliation -- from eight locations across Scarborough, Mississauga and Brampton, and in collaboration with over 40 community partners.  
  
Our mission is to identify core settlement needs and help our clients develop the skills and knowledge needed to become full and equal partners in Canadian society.  
  
CCS' Refugee Sponsorship Training Program (RSTP) brand works with private sponsors in seven cities across Canada, assisting them with comprehensive guidance and support in sponsoring refugees through the Private Sponsorship of Refugees Program.

How can educators get involved with the MTA and its initiatives?

Educators can get involved with the MTA by becoming members and participating in local union activities. The MTA encourages members to engage in professional development, attend conferences, and join committees focused on specific issues in education. Additionally, members can participate in advocacy efforts by contacting their legislators, attending rallies, and contributing to political action campaigns. The MTA also offers volunteer opportunities for members who wish to take a more active role in supporting the association's mission and initiatives.

About Kimpton Hotels & Restaurants
----------------------------------

At Kimpton, it’s always personal. We focus on what it means to be human and an individual. You’ll quickly learn Kimpton’s not just a hospitality job. Here, you’ll join a mission to make lives better. No biggie.  
  
The real you is a job requirement; your diverse background, talents, and quirks are what help our company connect meaningfully with our guests. You’ll lead your own personal career path while you help make each guest’s journey feel more personal. You won’t just punch a clock and count the hours; you’ll make it count.  
  
That’s why FORTUNE magazine has put Kimpton on its “Best Companies To Work For” list nine times. It’s why we score 100 on the Human Rights Campaign Foundation’s Corporate Equality Index every year. Our guests feel it too—it’s why we’re consistently ranked as a best-loved hospitality company.  
  
Our thriving company culture, numerous hospitality career tracks, and rich benefits and perks also make us one of the best places to work. We take care of all of our people with great benefits, like paid time off; medical, dental, and vision plans; life, short-term, and long-term disability insurance; 401(k) with employer matching; 6 weeks paid paternity/maternity leave; back-up child and elder care; robust professional and personal development through our own Kimpton University; and employee discounts at our 60+ hotels nationwide. Plus, we throw in some extra Kimpton-style perks, like wellness programs and, of course, pet insurance.  
  
We’re a best place to work because we’re driven by our passion for unscripted, heartfelt care. From the first whirl of a hula hoop at your employee orientation (yes, it happens) to every Kimpton Moment thereafter, you’re going to love it here as much as our guests do.

About World Associates LTD
--------------------------

World Associates, Ltd. (W.A.) is a non-profit development organization that alleviates basic felt needs leading to self-sufficiency, personal development, and health in the community, especially among the poor.  
  
For over 10 years, W.A. has strategically chosen one of the oldest neighborhoods of Aqaba, Jordan as its location. This enables the Aqaba branch to prepare the people of Aqaba for large tourism industry changes taking place in their city.  
  
By encouraging corporate social responsibility among business leaders, advocating educational opportunities for Aqaba citizens, teaching individual health and wellness courses, job skills training and other endeavors, W.A. will help Aqaba residents to be equipped and prepared as the Jordanian tourism industry expands.  
  
Starting in 2015, World Associates started some strategic initiatives to expand to other areas in Jordan. Projects were opened in E. Amman in May of 2015 and are scheduled for Irbid in January of 2016.

Shaka Sisulu is a South African social entrepreneur who has dedicated his life to creating positive change in his country and beyond. Sisulu has also been a vocal advocate for advancing gender equality and women's empowerment. Through his writing, speaking engagements, and media appearances, Sisulu has addressed topics ranging from youth empowerment to civic engagement, inspiring others to join the movement for social justice.  
  
Shaka Sisulu's impact as a social entrepreneur extends far beyond South Africa, reaching communities across the African continent and beyond. His innovative approach to advocacy and social change has made a lasting impact on the lives of countless individuals, demonstrating the power of collective action and the potential for positive transformation. About UC San Diego Health
-------------------------

UC San Diego Health and Health Sciences has been caring for the community and producing physicians for more than 50 years. In 1966, we established our first medical center. Two years later, in 1968, UC San Diego School of Medicine opened for business.  
  
Today, UC San Diego Health is the only academic health system in the San Diego region and is widely recognized as one of the premier health care systems in the United States. Its clinical facilities include:  
• Hillcrest Medical Center  
• East Campus Medical Center  
• Jacobs Medical Center – La Jolla  
• Moores Cancer Center (The only National Cancer Institute-designated Comprehensive Cancer Centers in the region.)  
• Shiley Eye Center  
• Sulpizio Cardiovascular Center (San Diego’s first comprehensive cardiovascular center)  
• Numerous primary and specialty practices of UC San Diego Medical Group located throughout Southern California.  
  
The UC San Diego School of Medicine is the region’s only medical school recognized among the best in the nation and in the world, in both research and in primary care. In addition to graduating thousands of world-class physicians, the faculty and staff of UC San Diego School of Medicine provides medical care to those in need, as well as programs or services that promote health and healing in response to identified community needs. Learn more about the School of Medicine at https://medschool.ucsd.edu and how we translate new discoveries from our laboratories to our patients at https://medschool.ucsd.edu/research.  
  
In addition, we are home to Skaggs School of Pharmacy and Pharmaceutical Sciences and the Herbert Wertheim School of Public Health and Human Longevity Science.  
  
The mission of UC San Diego Health is to deliver outstanding patient care through commitment to the community, groundbreaking research and inspired teaching. UC San Diego Health's vision is to create a healthier world – one life at a time – through new science, new medicine and new cures.

Owens & Minor, Inc. (NYSE: OMI) is a leading healthcare logistics company dedicated to Connecting the World of Medical Products to the Point of Care by providing vital supply chain services to healthcare providers and manufacturers of healthcare products. Owens & Minor provides logistics services across the spectrum of medical products from disposable medical supplies to devices and implants. With logistics platforms strategically located in the United States and Europe, Owens & Minor serves markets where three quarters of global healthcare spending occurs. Owens & Minor's customers span the healthcare market from independent hospitals to large integrated healthcare networks, as well as group purchasing organizations, healthcare products manufacturers, and the federal government. A FORTUNE 500 company, Owens & Minor is headquartered in Richmond, Virginia, and has annualized revenues exceeding $9 billion. For more information about Owens & Minor, visit the company website at www.owens-minor.com.The company places a high priority on its mission, vision and values, which focus on the well-being of customers, supply chain partners, teammates and shareholders. The company has developed a culture of recognition, reinforcement and reward for its teammates, who are vital to its success. Owens & Minor believes that high integrity is the guiding principle of doing business. Owens & Minor common shares are traded on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol OMI.

As one of the most recognizable and beloved players in the MLB, Aaron Judge continues to captivate audiences with his extraordinary talent and unwavering passion for the game. About PathWays PA
-----------------

OUR MISSION  
  
PathWays PA was founded in 1978 as the Women’s Association for Women’s Alternatives. It served as one of Pennsylvania’s first residential programs to keep low-income, vulnerable women together with their children and has grown to become one of the Greater Philadelphia Region’s foremost providers of residential and community-based services for women, children and families. Each year over 6,000 women, children and families benefit from our full complement of social services; job training and employment assistance; as well as outreach and residential programs as they move along the path to self-sufficiency.  
  
With offices throughout Southeastern Pennsylvania and advocacy initiatives on behalf of low-wage workers statewide, PathWays PA provides programs committed to the development of client self-sufficiency which leads to the fulfillment of our mission: To help women, teens, children and families achieve economic independence and family well-being.  
  
WHO WE ARE  
  
PathWays PA is accredited by the National Council on Accreditation. In recognition of our service to Pennsylvania we have received numerous awards. These include Oprah Winfrey’s Angel Network Award; Delaware County Chamber of Commerce Non-Profit of the Year; Philadelphia Department of Human Services Children’s Crusader Award; and The Child Welfare League of America’s Private Agency Advocate of the Year Award among countless other citations and recognition from both public and private entities.

About ECPAT-USA
---------------

ECPAT-USA is a 501(c)3 non-profit  
  
OUR VISION  
A world in which no child is bought, sold, or used for sex.  
  
OUR MISSION  
To protect every child’s basic human right to grow up free from the threat of sexual exploitation and trafficking. ECPAT-USA does this in four primary ways:  
ECPAT-USA advocates for federal and state legislation that prevents exploitation, protects children, and guarantees that any child who is subjected to sexual slavery or sex trafficking will not be prosecuted in the courts for prostitution;  
ECPAT-USA promotes corporate responsibility among private companies with a strong focus on the tourism sector.  
ECPAT-USA educates first responders and ordinary citizens about this issue so that they can identify victims and join us in the fight to better protect children.  
ECPAT-USA empowers youth to take the lead against human trafficking by equipping them with the knowledge and tools necessary to help them become activists against this terrible trade.

What services does PriceSpective offer to support market access for pharmaceutical products?

PriceSpective specializes in providing comprehensive market access solutions that include payer strategy development, pricing strategies, and market assessments. Their team conducts thorough analyses to understand market dynamics and payer requirements, ensuring that clients can effectively position their products for optimal access and reimbursement. Additionally, they offer tailored engagements to help clients navigate complex regulatory environments and develop robust value propositions.

How does PriceSpective assist with product valuations in the pharmaceutical industry?

PriceSpective employs a combination of quantitative and qualitative methodologies to deliver accurate product valuations. Their approach includes assessing market potential, competitive landscape, and clinical data to provide clients with a clear understanding of their product's worth. This service is essential for companies looking to make informed decisions regarding investments, partnerships, and strategic planning.

Can PriceSpective help with due diligence for potential business development opportunities?

Yes, PriceSpective offers due diligence services that are critical for companies exploring mergers, acquisitions, or partnerships in the pharmaceutical sector. Their team conducts in-depth evaluations of potential assets, including market assessments, financial analyses, and risk evaluations. This thorough process helps clients make informed decisions and identify opportunities that align with their strategic goals.

What industries does PriceSpective primarily serve?

PriceSpective primarily serves the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industries. They work with a range of clients, including large pharmaceutical companies, biotech firms, and emerging startups. Their expertise spans various therapeutic areas, enabling them to provide tailored insights and strategies that address the unique challenges and opportunities within these sectors.

How does PriceSpective approach payer implementation strategies?

PriceSpective takes a strategic approach to payer implementation by first understanding the specific needs and preferences of different payer groups. They collaborate with clients to develop targeted strategies that facilitate successful negotiations and ensure that products are positioned effectively within the market. This includes crafting compelling value propositions and supporting clients through the entire implementation process to maximize product uptake.

What is the significance of commercial assessments provided by PriceSpective?

Commercial assessments provided by PriceSpective are crucial for understanding the viability of a product in the market. These assessments evaluate factors such as market demand, competitive landscape, pricing strategies, and potential barriers to entry. By leveraging these insights, clients can make informed decisions about product launches, marketing strategies, and resource allocation, ultimately driving long-term value and success in the marketplace.

About Publicis Kaplan Thaler
----------------------------

You can either adapt to change, ignore it or lead it. Publicis Kaplan Thaler is a full service advertising agency that helps our clients take the lead.  
  
About  
On July 12, 2012, Publicis New York and the Kaplan Thaler Group merged to form Publicis Kaplan Thaler. The combined New York-based entity, with over 700 employees, became the North American flagship agency within the Publicis Worldwide Network of over 200 offices in 82 countries. The merger combined the strengths of Publicis New York’s vast global expertise with the Kaplan Thaler Group’s reputation for building iconic brands that became part of the culture. From the onset, Publicis Kaplan Thaler offered clients an entrepreneurial spirit with global scale that is idea-driven across all communications platforms. The agency is fully integrated with digital, social and technology at its core. Publicis Kaplan Thaler is led by Chairman Linda Kaplan Thaler and President / Chief Creative Officer Rob Feakins.  
  
Mission  
The one constant in this world is change. You can either adapt to it, ignore it, or lead it. "Lead the Change" is both our mission and our call to action. It speaks to our entrepreneurial spirit and our roots as an agency. It defines the way we think about brands, ideas and relationships, and it's alive in our work. Change that helps them to redefine the landscape and forge ahead of the competition. Change that lets them become part of the public consciousness, and create a movement of passionate advocates.  
  
Description  
Publicis Worldwide, headquartered in Paris, is the largest global advertising agency network within the Publicis Groupe holding company. Publicis Worldwide has nearly 9,000 employees across 218 offices and 82 countries. In North America, Publicis Kaplan Thaler is the largest office in the region with 700+ employees. Clients include P&G, Citi, AFLAC, Wendy's, L'Oreal, Nestle, Hilton, Merck, TriHonda and Pfizer, among others.

About Louisville Public Media
-----------------------------

Louisville Public Media (LPM) is an independent, community supported non-profit serving our Louisville metropolitan area with three distinct public radio stations and an investigative newsroom. 89.3 WFPL News Louisville provides local, national and international news, public affairs and cultural programming. 90.5 WUOL Classical Louisville is our city’s only classical music and fine arts radio station. 91.9 WFPK Independent Louisville showcases independent, alternative music and an array of musical genres. The Kentucky Center for Investigative Reporting (KyCIR) shines the light of accountability on the people and institutions in power.  
  
LPM reaches more than 300,000 people each week across our platforms. These listeners and users share a desire for rigorous, independent journalism, long-form coverage of local news and culture, insight into national and international issues, and a breadth of musical exploration.  
  
LPM also serves as a community convener for public affairs, civil discourse, and culture. It presents public panels and free public concerts, and leverages community resources through partnerships and media sponsorships.  
  
The local community provides more than 90% of the funding for Louisville Public Media. More than 70% of our expenses go towards programming.

About Daniel Ek

Daniel Ek is a visionary entrepreneur and the driving force behind Spotify, the world's leading audio-streaming platform. As the co-founder and CEO, Ek has revolutionized the way we consume music, bringing it into the digital age and making it accessible to millions of people around the globe. With a focus on innovation, user experience, and artist empowerment, Ek has turned Spotify into a cultural phenomenon, disrupting the music industry and reshaping the way we discover, share, and enjoy our favorite tunes.  
  
Born in Stockholm, Sweden, in 1983, Daniel Ek showed an early interest in technology and entrepreneurship. At the age of 13, he started his first business, developing websites for local companies. This experience set the stage for his future endeavors and laid a solid foundation for his career in the tech industry. Ek's passion for music also played a crucial role in shaping his future path. Growing up, he spent countless hours listening to his favorite artists and immersing himself in the world of music.  
  
With a deep understanding of music and technology, Ek saw an opportunity to revolutionize the way people access and consume music. In 2006, he co-founded Spotify, a streaming platform that aimed to provide legal access to a vast catalog of music at affordable prices. Ek's vision was to create a service that offered both convenience for consumers and fair compensation for artists. His unwavering belief in the power of streaming technology and its positive impact on the industry became the driving force behind Spotify's success.  
  
Under Ek's leadership, Spotify has transformed the music industry, challenging traditional distribution models and paving the way for the rise of streaming services. Ek prioritized user experience from the beginning, creating an intuitive and personalized interface that made discovering new music effortless. By leveraging data and algorithms, Spotify revolutionized music recommendations, allowing users to discover songs and artists tailored to their tastes. This approach not only elevated the user experience but also provided independent and emerging artists with a platform to reach a global audience, democratizing the music industry in unprecedented ways.  
  
One of Ek's most significant achievements has been his dedication to creating a fair and sustainable future for artists. Recognizing that musicians often struggle to earn a living from streaming platforms, he championed initiatives to increase royalty rates and improve revenue-sharing models. Ek has worked tirelessly to strike licensing deals with major record labels and negotiated partnerships with artists, ensuring they receive fair compensation for their creative contributions. His efforts have empowered artists to thrive financially within the streaming landscape, making Spotify a platform that artists can trust and rely on to support their careers.  
  
Beyond music, Ek has expanded Spotify's offerings to include podcasts, allowing the platform to become a one-stop-shop for all audio content. This bold move has further cemented Spotify's position as a leader in the industry and has captured the attention of podcast creators and listeners worldwide. By investing in original and exclusive content, Ek has continued to push boundaries and shape the future of audio entertainment.  
  
Daniel Ek's drive, vision, and commitment to innovation have earned him accolades and recognition as one of the most influential figures in the music and tech industries. His ability to disrupt traditional norms and create opportunities for artists and listeners alike has revolutionized the way we consume and appreciate music. As the CEO of Spotify, Ek continues to push the boundaries of what is possible, exploring new technologies and avenues for growth. With his unwavering dedication to empowering artists and improving the user experience, Daniel Ek has proven that his impact extends far beyond just the software behind Spotify - he has forever changed the way we connect with and enjoy music.

Alexander College is a private educational institution which offers Associate Degrees as well as first- and second-year university courses for students wishing to transfer to a Bachelor degree program in Canada.  
  
Alexander College is a member of the British Columbia Council on Admissions and Transfer (BCCAT) system and has established transfer agreements with colleges and universities across British Columbia, including the most prestigious universities in the province.  
  
Alexander College offers three degree programs: Associate of Arts, Associate of Arts (Business), and Associate of Science. These degrees are approved to be offered in British Columbia by the Minister of Advanced Education, and are recognized by colleges and universities in North America and around the world. An Associate Degree is designed to broaden knowledge, provide greater opportunity for success in the workplace, and lay a solid foundation for further study.  
  
Alexander College campuses are conveniently located in downtown Vancouver and in central Burnaby. Our students enjoy a vibrant urban environment with instant access to transportation, shopping, and entertainment, as well as the natural beauty of the area.

Cognota (formerly Synapse) is the first and only operations platform for corporate Learning and Development teams. This first-of-its-kind software allows our customers to get better visibility into the training needs of their businesses and consolidate the disparate tools they are using so they can make better, more strategic decisions about learning needs and investments.  
  
Founded originally as Synapse, Cognota changed its name in April 2022 and has clients in multiple sectors around the world. For more information visit www.cognota.com.

About Interpro
--------------

Interpro has been in the Australian market for over 30 years and has established a reputation for providing bespoke, value add consultative services to both clients and candidates. This is based on building long term partnerships that exceed expectations and are anchored in honesty, transparency and professionalism.  
  
Our specialisms are Data, Cloud Apps, Development, Cyber Security and Project Services.  
  
We have placed top talent across Australia, Europe, the UK, Asia, the Middle East and the United States of America. We’ve stood the test of time, and owe it all to our commitment to our most important asset, our people.  
  
Our focus is in providing exceptional service, and we put specialisation at the core of everything. This means you can be confident you’ll receive a market-leading service, wherever you are in the world.  
  
Our Vision  
To be known as the leading provider of selected in-demand IT skills by delivering a quality of service to our candidates, contractors and customers that is second to none – our reputation is everything!  
  
Our Purpose  
We serve our candidates and contractors by matching them with the best opportunities in the market. In doing this, we also help our customers grow their businesses by providing the right talent.  
  
Our Mission  
We will understand the different stakeholder groups that includes external parties as well as our own team and be totally focused on our objectives that will deliver superior satisfaction, repeat business and employee retention. Good service and treating all people with respect are deeply ingrained in our culture. Our people are vital to our business and we want them to love working for Interpro and be proud of our Brand. We will reward loyalty and hard work as we value everyone's contribution.  
  
Our Brand Promise  
It is the people we know….  
Our organisation seeks to understand talent pools in our specialist areas better than anyone.

BHS is a brand on a mission to put British Home Stores back to where it belongs, as one of the UK’s most iconic retail brands.  
  
In 1928 the first British Home Store opened its doors in Brixton. Now in 2016, our stores and online cover every corner of the country, and like Great Britain herself, we’ve seen more than a few changes. Though also like Britain, our principles remain unchanged; the same warmth of welcome, the same generosity of spirit, the same determination to go the extra mile.  
  
Today, we’re proudly independent and back with renewed abilities, a new determination and a new proposition to invite everyone to a world of British Style made effortless. And if you visit BHS today, you'll still find all products you've come to expect from BHS - fashion, homewares and of course lighting - but brighter and better than ever!  
There’s never been a better time to join us as we see the rise in investment and put together an exciting strategy to inject new life into the brand and bring the best of British style to every community in our country.  
We embrace change, adapt quickly, are enthusiastic about moving forward, and excited about what’s around the corner. We believe in developing people, unleashing their potential and encouraging personality.

Since our founding in 2006, we have transformed the banking industry by bringing a traditional credit product - the installment loan - online and we’ve been on the fast track ever since. We are one of the first fintechs to acquire a national bank charter, which has transformed our business economics and introduced all new capabilities, and now others are following our lead, validating the strength of our model. We are one of America’s largest providers of unsecured personal loans, originating more than $70 billion in loans to our over 4 million high-FICO, high-income members and helping them save millions on their cost of credit. And we’re just getting started.  
  
The Problem We Are Solving:  
More than 50% of Americans are living paycheck to paycheck – and that includes people making over $100K annually. We’re able to provide cost-effective ways for our members to bridge cash flow gaps and better ways to lend, spend, and save.  
  
A Culture that Delivers  
  
Impact: We’re tackling big problems, but we’re a small enough organization for each individual to make a real difference  
  
People: We’re a group of smart, kind, low-ego, and values-driven people from a wide variety of industries and backgrounds who are committed to our mission  
  
Ideas: We seek out the best ideas – no matter where they come from – to look beyond what is possible today  
  
Values: It’s not just what you accomplish, it’s also how you accomplish it that matters

About Universidade Federal de Ouro Preto
----------------------------------------

Tradition, modernity and innovation are characteristics in the identity of the Federal University of Ouro Preto (Universidade Federal de Ouro Preto - UFOP). It was the innovative spirit, present since the creation of the School of Pharmacy, in 1839, and the School of Mines, in 1876, that became the basis from which would be born, in 1969, the Federal University of Ouro Preto. Ten years later it had already incorporated the Institute of Human and Social Sciences (Instituto de Ciências Humanas e Sociais - ICHS). Driven towards the strengthening of teaching, research and extension, other academic unities were created: the Institute of Philosophy, Arts and Culture (Instituto de Filosofia, Artes e Cultura - IFAC); the Institute of Exact and Biological Sciences (Instituto de Ciências Exatas e Biológicas - ICEB); The School of Nutrition (Escola de Nutrição - ENUT); the Center of Open and Distance Education (Centro de Educação Aberta e a Distância - CEAD); the Institute of Exact and Applied Sciences (Instituto de Ciências Exatas e Aplicadas - ICEA) and the Institute of Applied Social Sciences (Instituto de Ciências Sociais Aplicadas - ICSA). Today, UFOP is a reference in Brazil among the important Federal Institutions of Higher Education (Instituições Federais de Ensino Superior - IFES) of the country. This projection is due to its singularity on the historical dimensions of education, research, innovation and community involvement and especially to the appreciation given to its human patrimony: students, faculty and administrative-staff members. With campuses in three different cities, Ouro Preto, Mariana and João Monlevade, the university is located in the mesoregion of Belo Horizonte, expanding itself as far as João Monlevade, and in the microregion of Ouro Preto. Currently, the university occupies an area of approximately 151,000 m² (about 180,000 yd2), with over 150 classrooms and 140 teaching and research labs.

About That Fish Place - That Pet Place

That Fish Place - That Pet Place, a 50 year-old family-owned and operated business whose core focus is to deliver the ultimate pet experience.  
  
We specialize in pets and aquatics. We work to create the kind of experience that creates a customer's confidence in the advice and products we deliver every day, to the family members they love. Over the years, our reputation as the finest pet supply store has become widely known, and people from all over the east coast shop at our 88,000 square foot retail store.  
  
That Fish Place began in 1973, as a small family owned aquarium store owned by Bernie and Sandy Lebowitz. The store was originally located where the Isaac’s restaurant is now. The goal of the business was to make aquarium supplies more affordable for fish hobbyists. Bernie and Sandy’s son, Scott, and daughter, Beth, purchased the business from their parents in the late 1990’s. During this time, other pet supply categories were added to the business and the company was rebranded as That Fish Place - That Pet Place. In 2015 the company was purchased by long-time employees Rick and Chrisi Amour with the goal of continuing to grow the business that the Lebowitz family had so successfully established.

About Challenge Wales
---------------------

The award winning sail training charity Challenge Wales operates Challenge Wales | Wales' Tall Ship (72 foot ex-round the world racing yacht) and Adventure Wales (60 foot ocean-going vessel) using sailing as a platform to develop employability and life skills in young people aged 12 - 25 years. With many young people having never seen the sea before, let alone sailed, the experience of being crew and running a boat with no sailing experience can be life-changing, increases awareness and understanding of the ocean environment and sustainability plus also brings positive mental health and improved wellbeing.  
  
Sail training promotes:  
Teamwork, working to a schedule, communication skills, leadership, respect for others, responsibility and improves self-esteem and confidence. It also places the young person into a positive focused environment and helps develop a 'can-do' attitude.  
Challenge Wales has worked with young carers, autistic, visually impaired, those in school, college or university, those with learning difficulties, those with low literacy, those doing their Duke of Edinburgh's Award Gold Award, those who have anxiety or depression, young people in employment, those who want a fun adventure and to experience new places and meet new people.  
  
Adult sailing:  
Challenge Wales can also help adults (18 - 80 years) develop teamwork and leadership skills or just an opportunity to be on the water away from everyday life.  
Companies can also get involved through sponsorship opportunities, and supporting their local community youth group, or through employee volunteering, group sailing activities including Corporate days and more.  
  
Challenge Wales is predominantly run by volunteers.

About Bishop Ford Central Catholic High School
----------------------------------------------

Bishop Ford Central Catholic High School, located in the heart of Brooklyn, New York, is committed to providing a holistic education that nurtures the mind, body, and spirit of its students. With a strong foundation in the Roman Catholic tradition, the school emphasizes the importance of faith, respect for the nation, and the love of knowledge, God, others, and oneself. The administration, faculty, and staff work collaboratively to create an environment where students can thrive academically, socially, and spiritually.  
  
At Bishop Ford, the educational philosophy is rooted in the threefold aim of Catholic education, as articulated in the Bishops' pastoral, "To Teach as Jesus Did." This approach ensures that students are not only prepared for college but also equipped to become responsible parents, engaged neighbors, and conscientious citizens. The curriculum is designed to challenge students while fostering critical thinking and a love for learning.  
  
In addition to a robust academic program, Bishop Ford Central Catholic High School offers a variety of extracurricular activities, including athletics, arts, and community service, allowing students to explore their interests and develop leadership skills. The dedicated faculty, whose expertise is reflected in the comprehensive Bishop Ford Central Catholic High School teachers list, plays a vital role in guiding students on their educational journey. By instilling values of compassion, integrity, and respect, Bishop Ford aims to cultivate well-rounded individuals who are prepared to make meaningful contributions to society.

About Goodwill Industries of Greater Nebraska
---------------------------------------------

Goodwill Industries of Greater Nebraska is a 501(c)(3) non-profit organization provided services and support to over 2,000 people living with disabilities and barriers last year across greater Nebraska. Sometimes these are individuals who face specific challenges, such as language barriers, a brain injury, substance use or physical or mental disabilities. Our services promote independence and access to the community, help people become successfully employed, support goals of wellness and recovery, teach responsible behavior and provide safe and affordable housing.  
  
The proceeds from the sale of donated clothing and goods in our retail stores provides funding for our programs and services.  
  
Goodwill Industries of Greater Nebraska is an independently run member of Goodwill Industries International. Our organization is overseen by a volunteer Board of Directors, comprised of local community leaders, who ensure we fulfill our mission and make positive changes in the greater Nebraska area.

### Frequently Asked Questions about Goodwill Industries of Greater Nebraska

Who is the CEO of Goodwill Industries Of Greater Nebraska?

Kris Brown is the CEO of Goodwill Industries Of Greater Nebraska. To contact Kris Brown email at [\[email protected\]](https://contactout.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection)
.

The decision makers in Goodwill Industries Of Greater Nebraska are Audrey Defrank, Cheryl Brei, Curtiss Dill, etc. Click to Find [Goodwill Industries Of Greater Nebraska decision makers emails](https://contactout.com/dashboard/search?company=Goodwill%20Industries%20Of%20Greater%20Nebraska&seniority=founder%7Cc_suite%7Cvice_president%7Cowner%7Cdirector)
.

What services does Goodwill Industries of Greater Nebraska provide for individuals with disabilities?

Goodwill Industries of Greater Nebraska offers a variety of services aimed at supporting individuals with disabilities. These include employment and career services, which help individuals find and maintain jobs, as well as behavioral health services that provide mental health support. Additionally, Goodwill offers developmental disability services, ensuring that individuals receive the necessary resources and assistance to lead fulfilling lives.

How can I donate items to Goodwill Industries of Greater Nebraska?

Donating items to Goodwill Industries of Greater Nebraska is easy and greatly appreciated. You can drop off your gently used clothing, household items, and other goods at any of our donation centers located throughout the region. For larger donations, you may also schedule a pickup by contacting your local Goodwill location. All donations are tax-deductible, and the proceeds from sales help fund our programs and services.

What types of employment services does Goodwill offer?

Goodwill Industries of Greater Nebraska provides comprehensive employment services, including job training, resume writing assistance, interview preparation, and job placement services. We focus on helping individuals overcome barriers to employment, such as disabilities or lack of experience, by offering personalized support and resources tailored to each person's needs.

Can individuals without disabilities access Goodwill's services?

Yes, Goodwill Industries of Greater Nebraska serves all individuals, regardless of disability status. While our primary focus is on supporting those with disabilities and barriers, we also provide services such as thrift store shopping and community engagement opportunities that are open to everyone. Our goal is to create inclusive environments that benefit the entire community.

What is the mission of Goodwill Industries of Greater Nebraska?

The mission of Goodwill Industries of Greater Nebraska is to enhance the quality of life for individuals and families by providing opportunities for employment, education, and community engagement. We strive to empower people with disabilities and barriers to achieve their full potential through meaningful work and support services, ultimately promoting independence and self-sufficiency.

How does Goodwill support the local community?

Goodwill Industries of Greater Nebraska supports the local community by providing essential services that promote employment, education, and personal development. Our thrift stores offer affordable shopping options while generating revenue to fund our programs. Additionally, we engage in community outreach and partnerships with local organizations to address the needs of individuals facing barriers, ensuring that we contribute positively to the overall well-being of the communities we serve.

About St. Vincent de Paul Dayton
--------------------------------

We are a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization offering assistance, shelter, and hope in greater Dayton. Our mission is to, with Christian purpose, accompany those in need one person at a time by focusing on shelter, food, and clothing. Our vision is to improve the lives of people in need in the Miami Valley. We aid those struggling with homelessness and poverty by providing emergency shelter, supportive housing, food, clothing and household items, and guidance on the path to leading a self-sustaining life. We provide help to individuals and families who are on the brink of losing their housing, those who are currently homeless, and those working to secure and maintain permanent housing. Contact us today for help or to support our mission.

### Frequently Asked Questions about St. Vincent de Paul Dayton

Who are the decision makers in St. Vincent de Paul Dayton?

What types of assistance does St. Vincent de Paul Dayton provide?

St. Vincent de Paul Dayton offers a variety of assistance programs aimed at helping individuals and families in need. These include emergency assistance for basic needs, housing support, food pantry services, financial assistance, and counseling. We also provide shelter for the homeless, supportive housing options, and volunteer opportunities for those looking to give back to the community.

How can I access emergency assistance from St. Vincent de Paul Dayton?

To access emergency assistance, individuals can contact our office directly or visit our website for more information. We typically require some basic information about your situation to determine eligibility. Our team is dedicated to providing support and will guide you through the process to ensure you receive the help you need.

What services are available at the St. Vincent de Paul Dayton Thrift Store?

The St. Vincent de Paul Dayton Thrift Store offers a wide range of gently used clothing, household items, and furniture at affordable prices. Proceeds from the store directly support our programs and services for those in need. Additionally, we welcome donations of items in good condition, which can be dropped off at the store or arranged for pickup through our donation services.

How can I volunteer with St. Vincent de Paul Dayton?

Volunteering with St. Vincent de Paul Dayton is a rewarding way to give back to the community. We offer various volunteer opportunities, including working in our thrift store, assisting in the food pantry, and helping with events. Interested individuals can fill out a volunteer application on our website or contact our volunteer coordinator for more information on how to get involved.

What is the process for donating a vehicle to St. Vincent de Paul Dayton?

Donating a vehicle to St. Vincent de Paul Dayton is a straightforward process. You can fill out a vehicle donation form on our website, and our team will contact you to arrange for pickup. Donated vehicles are sold, and the proceeds help fund our programs and services. Plus, you may be eligible for a tax deduction for your generous contribution.

What types of events does St. Vincent de Paul Dayton host?

St. Vincent de Paul Dayton hosts a variety of events throughout the year to raise awareness and support for our mission. These include fundraising events, community outreach programs, and volunteer appreciation gatherings. We also participate in local events to connect with the community and share information about our services. Check our website for upcoming events and how you can participate.

About Anesthesia Patient Safety Foundation (APSF)
-------------------------------------------------

The Anesthesia Patient Safety Foundation (APSF) is the pioneer organization dedicated to assuring patient safety. Formed in 1985 with the mission that "no patient shall be harmed from anesthesia," APSF has been the leader in the proactive, successful efforts to dramatically improve the safety of anesthesia administration and reduce adverse events. The Executive Committee of APSF believes that the reason for the success of its efforts has been its attention to early identification of safety problems, promoting research, disseminating information, and promoting an emphasis on patient safety in clinical practice. The APSF program has helped create a cadre of experts and a culture and infrastructure devoted to promoting safety. We believe that these and other influences on the profession of anesthesia, in particular the strong support of the American Society of Anesthesiologists and other anesthesia professional societies, have combined to produce our common goal: maximum safety for all patients undergoing anesthesia. We stand ready to assist others and are available for further discussion of these issues to shape the national agenda for patient safety.  
  
Our Vision  
That no patient shall be harmed by anesthesia.  
  
Mission Statement  
The APSF's Mission is to improve continually the safety of patients during anesthesia care by encouraging and conducting:  
  
safety research and education;  
patient safety programs and campaigns;  
national and international exchange of information and ideas.

About Bimeks
------------

1990 yılında Akgiray Ailesi tarafından kurulan Bimeks, 2007 ve 2008 yıllarında CNBC–E Business, Interpro Bilişim 500 tarafından Türkiye’nin en hızlı büyüyen şirketi olarak değerlendirilmiştir.  
  
Müşterilerine bilişim teknolojisi, tüketici elektroniği, beyaz eşya ve küçük ev aletleri sunan Bimeks, Türkiye’nin lider ve öncü markalarından biridir.  
  
Özgün hizmet ve perakendecilik konsepti ile mutlu, güvenli ve keyifli bir alışveriş deneyimi yaşatan Bimeks, müşteri sadakatinde liderliğini korumaktadır.  
  
Bimeks, İstanbul Menkul Kıymetler Borsası'nda işlem görmeye başlayan ilk teknoloji perakende şirketi olma özelliğini taşımasının yanı sıra AVM'de açılan ilk teknoloji perakende şirketidir.  
  
Bimeks, verimliliğe odaklı politika ve uygulamalarına özkaynaklarını güçlendirme atılımını da ilave etmiştir. Kendine özgü franchise sistemi ile sektörüne öncülük eden şirket çok kanallılığı stratejisi olarak benimsemiş ve kendi mağazaları, franchise mağazalar ve online satış kanalı ile erişim ağını her geçen gün büyütmektedir.  
  
Türkiye'nin dört bir yanına yayılmayı hedefleyen Bimeks, 81 ilde en az bir Bimeks mağazası ile var olmayı hedeflemektedir. Dünya pazarına açılarak uluslararası bir marka olmayı uzun dönemli hedefleri arasında bulunduran Bimeks'in çoğunluk hissesi Akgiray Ailesi’ne aittir.

James Corden is a multi-talented English actor and comedian known for his infectious charm, razor-sharp wit, and versatile performances. Born on August 22, 1978, in Hillingdon, London, Corden's early passion for performing led him to become one of the most recognizable faces in British entertainment.  
  
Corden's journey in showbiz began at a young age when he attended the Jackie Palmer Stage School, where he honed his acting, singing, and dancing abilities. At just 18 years old, he scored his breakthrough role in the hit British sitcom "Fat Friends," where he portrayed Jamie Rymer, an aspiring footballer struggling with his weight. This role showcased Corden's natural comedic timing and marked the beginning of his successful career in the entertainment industry.  
  
However, it was his collaboration with fellow actor and writer Ruth Jones that catapulted Corden into mainstream success. The pair co-created and starred in the critically acclaimed sitcom "Gavin & Stacey," which aired from 2007 to 2010. Corden played the lovable Smithy, a loyal friend with an endearing sense of humor. The show's witty writing, relatable characters, and heartfelt storytelling resonated with audiences, earning it a dedicated fanbase and numerous awards.  
  
Corden's undeniable talent and magnetic presence soon caught the attention of Hollywood, leading him to venture into the film industry. In 2011, he starred in the critically acclaimed comedy "The History Boys," which followed a group of unruly students pursuing acceptance into prestigious universities. Corden's portrayal of Timms, an endearing troublemaker, showcased his ability to bring both humor and depth to his characters.  
  
However, it was Corden's role in the musical comedy "Into the Woods" (2014) that truly solidified his status as a versatile performer. He played the role of the Baker, a humble and compassionate character on a quest to lift a curse. Corden's enchanting singing voice, combined with his impeccable comedic timing, garnered widespread praise from critics and audiences alike.  
  
Corden's undeniable talent eventually garnered him his own late-night talk show, "The Late Late Show with James Corden," which premiered in 2015. The show became an instant hit, known for its innovative and entertaining segments such as "Carpool Karaoke" and "Crosswalk the Musical." Corden's ability to create an engaging and relaxed atmosphere, combined with his genuine curiosity and rapport with guests, has made him a beloved figure in the late-night talk show landscape.  
  
Beyond his acting and comedic pursuits, Corden has made a significant impact through his philanthropy work and activism. Corden's compassionate nature and dedication to making a positive difference in the world have endeared him to fans globally, solidifying his status as a true humanitarian.  
  
In addition to his on-screen success, Corden has also enjoyed a thriving career as a host and emcee. He has hosted prestigious award shows such as the Tony Awards and the Grammy Awards, showcasing his ability to entertain diverse audiences while keeping the show running smoothly.  
  
In a career that spans over two decades, James Corden has established himself as a force to be reckoned with in the entertainment industry. With his remarkable talent, infectious personality, and exceptional comedic timing, Corden continues to captivate audiences worldwide. Scott Colby is a passionate advocate for mental wellness and team cohesion, currently serving as the Owner of Say It With Gratitude. His approach not only promotes physical well-being but also nurtures emotional resilience, making it a holistic solution for today’s fast-paced work environment.

With expertise in adventure travel, wellness, public speaking, and program management, Scott is dedicated to creating meaningful experiences that inspire individuals and teams to reconnect with nature and each other. Duke University, located in Durham, North Carolina, is a prestigious research institution renowned for its commitment to academic excellence and innovation. Established in 1838, Duke has evolved into a leading university that serves a diverse range of industries, including healthcare, law, business, engineering, and the humanities. The university is particularly recognized for its cutting-edge research and interdisciplinary programs, which leverage advanced technologies and methodologies to address complex global challenges.  
  
Duke offers a wide array of undergraduate, graduate, and professional degree programs across its ten schools and colleges, including the renowned Duke Law School and the Fuqua School of Business. The university is also home to the Duke Global Health Institute, which focuses on improving health outcomes worldwide through research, education, and policy development. With a strong emphasis on experiential learning, Duke encourages students to engage in research, internships, and community service, fostering a holistic educational experience.  
  
The university's commitment to sustainability and social responsibility is evident in its various initiatives aimed at reducing environmental impact and promoting equity. Duke employs state-of-the-art technologies in its research endeavors, utilizing data analytics, artificial intelligence, and biotechnology to push the boundaries of knowledge. As a hub for innovation and collaboration, Duke University not only prepares its students for successful careers but also contributes significantly to the advancement of society through its research and community engagement efforts. For more information, visit their official website at http://duke.edu.

George's creativity and ingenuity are consistently on display, as he devises clever solutions to outmaneuver their foes and save the day.  
  
In addition to his mischievous nature, George is also known for his caring and compassionate personality. He looks out for Harold, and the two share a deep bond that anchors their friendship throughout the series. George's willingness to take risks and champion their shared dreams of becoming successful comic book creators reflects his adventurous spirit and unwavering optimism.  
  
George's character resonates with young readers as a role model who celebrates individuality, creativity, and the power of friendship. His resourcefulness and unwavering determination inspire children to embrace their unique talents and pursue their passions, despite obstacles and setbacks. Through George's escapades, readers are encouraged to think outside the box and find joy in their imagination, much like the mischievous fourth grader they have come to love.  
  
Overall, George Beard is a dynamic and spirited character whose vibrant personality and imaginative storytelling have delighted readers for years. His mischievous antics, quick-witted humor, and empathetic nature make him a standout protagonist in children's literature, capturing the hearts of young readers as they embark on exciting escapades with George and Harold in the whimsical world of "Captain Underpants."

4titude® Ltd specialises in the design, manufacture and marketing of consumables and bench top instrumentation for the life sciences industry.

•PCR, QPCR & sequencing tubes, plates and seals for manual and robotic use  
•Assay Plates and seals for imaging, recommended by plate reader manufacturers  
•Quality polypropylene storage plates of varying volumes for manual and robotic use  
•Specific adhesive plates seals, including gas permeable and moisture resistant seals  
•Automated and semi-automated heat sealing instrumentation and materials  
•Liquid handling robotics  
  
In addition we offer custom design toolmaking and injection moulding services.  
  
The launch of the 4titude® FrameStar® range of two-component PCR plates, in 2006, marked the beginning of the on-going success story that is 4titude®. This range is now the most comprehensive of 2-component (polycarbonate frame) consumables in the life sciences market.

About Neurocrine Biosciences
----------------------------

Neurocrine Biosciences is a neuroscience-focused, biopharmaceutical company with a simple purpose: to relieve suffering for people with great needs, but few options. We are dedicated to discovering and developing life-changing treatments for patients with under-addressed neurological, neuroendocrine and neuropsychiatric disorders. The company’s diverse portfolio includes FDA-approved treatments for tardive dyskinesia, Parkinson’s disease, endometriosis\* and uterine fibroids\* , as well as clinical programs in multiple therapeutic areas. For three decades, we have applied our unique insight into neuroscience and the interconnections between brain and body systems to treat complex conditions. We relentlessly pursue medicines to ease the burden of debilitating diseases and disorders, because you deserve brave science.  
  
Review our Community Guidelines: https://bit.ly/3L8M8hx

About Drip Capital
------------------

Trade finance is an age-old paper-based industry dominated by banks that focus on large, established corporate customers. Today, however, small businesses account for 40% of international trade, but still remain neglected by banks. Drip Capital is using technology to re-build core parts of the international trade finance infrastructure and make the underwriting and financing of international B2B transactions seamless for small businesses. Our mission is to level the playing field for small businesses located in emerging markets and to finance their international trade at the click of a button.  
  
Drip Capital is a California- and India-based fintech company, focused on solving the working capital problem for SME exporters using technology. The company was founded by Pushkar Mukewar and Neil Kothari, both roommates at Wharton. The team now comprises of engineers, data scientists and trade finance veterans across Palo Alto, and three offices in India - Mumbai, Delhi, and Bangalore.

K12 offers a personalized approach to education that removes barriers to learning and meets students where they are. We manage public and private online schools, and develop innovative curricula and technology to help students reach their full potential.  
  
While many students thrive in traditional brick-and-mortar schools, others feel constrained by a model that simply does not fit their needs. Since our founding in 1999, we have continually improved our approach to better reflect how students learn, grow and evolve.  
  
As pioneers in online learning, we have helped develop a new model of learning that allows kindergarten through high school students to move beyond the physical walls of the classroom. Our various education offerings include career readiness programs, support services, blended learning, dual credit courses and many others. They are designed to help every student—regardless of geographic, socioeconomic, or academic circumstance—achieve better outcomes through a personalized approach.  
  
We recognize that teachers are at the center of every student’s experience and we are focused on recruiting and training inspired educators who have dedicated themselves to developing young and able minds. We believe that when teachers succeed, students succeed and are dedicated to expanding our national network of educator supports and professional development opportunities.  
  
Whether it’s providing students with unique opportunities for growth or equipping talented teachers with the tools they need to succeed, we are committed to a future in which students and parents are empowered, with traditional, blended and online learning options, to design an educational path that works best for them.

By showcasing golf’s greatest players, the PGA TOUR engages, inspires and positively impacts our fans, partners and communities worldwide.

Members on the PGA TOUR represent the world’s best players, hailing from 29 countries and territories (93 members are from outside the United States). Worldwide, PGA TOUR tournaments are broadcast to 212 countries and territories in 23 languages. Virtually all tournaments are organized as non-profit organizations to maximize charitable giving.  
  
In 2019, tournaments across all Tours generated a record $204.3 million for local and national charitable organizations, bringing the all-time total to more than $3 billion. To learn more about the positive impact the PGA TOUR has on the communities in which we play, please visit www.pgatour.com/impact.

About Inventors Groups Of America
---------------------------------

IGA is a group founded in 2017 by the leaders of the independent inventor community. Our goal is two-fold. First, IGA seeks to strengthen and support inventor groups throughout the world. Second, we aim to teach individuals how to best commercialize their ideas for new products and inventions.  
  
Ideas from individuals drive innovation. Most inventors do not have the knowledge and/or tools to commercialize their creativity, whether by starting their own business or licensing.  
  
IGA provides inventors with free educational resources, high-quality information, access to trustworthy individuals who want to give back, and a supportive community. Our website is a place for inventors to learn and share. Our monthly meetings introduce guest speakers and provide a platform for members to ask questions, share suggestions, and get assistance from others in the group.  
  
On our website find:  
  
Definitions of licensing and venturing terms.  
General information on various industries.  
Intellectual property strategies, particularly for those on a budget.  
Trade show listings.  
Proven steps for licensing product ideas.  
Tips on venturing from serial entrepreneurs .  
A directory of local and regional inventor organizations.  
Every webinar we have ever held!  
  
If you are an inventor group leader, please join our monthly meetings to learn best practices from other leaders and be inspired to continue fulfilling your mission. The inventing community needs you.  
  
We're stronger together.
