About Food Lifeline
-------------------

Feeding people facing hunger today and solving hunger for tomorrow.  
  
Every year, nearly 40% of our country's food ends up in landfills while millions of people go hungry. Food Lifeline rescues and redistributes healthy, nutritious food to people in need. We receive millions of pounds of surplus food from farmers, manufacturers, grocery stores, restaurants, and retailers every year. Our Hunger Solution Center, completed in 2016, has 190,000 square feet of space to hold this rescued food before volunteers sort and repack it. Food Lifeline then delivers it to more than 350 food banks, shelters, and meal programs throughout Western Washington - providing 280,000 meals every to our most vulnerable community members.  
  
At the same time, we are working to solve hunger for future by advocating for change and partnering with other organizations and agencies dedicated to ending hunger. The Hunger Solution Center is a hub for innovation and partnership that allows our community to join the movement to end hunger. We convene people at all levels to mobilize efforts that address hunger and other measures of poverty.  
  
It is easy and effective to donate your food, funds, voice, or time towards ending hunger. Visit FoodLifeline.org and find out how you can get involved.

FactEntry is a leading source of credit data for the global debt market. Our goal is to develop resources and products to improve transparency in credit markets and improve data, helping clients manage their data and information more effectively.  
  
Among our several products are:  
  
· FIDO, a fixed income database search engine (BondPDF.com)  
  
· CATS, a corporate action tracking service (CAalerts.com)  
  
· BondPDF, a library of over 1,000,000 bonds issued around the globe  
  
. Daily Bond Valuation service for illiquid bonds. (BondMetric.com)  
  
We also customize products based on our clients’ needs. Through our support of fixed income and credit professionals, we have been able to assist analysts in calibrating credit risk, interest rate risk, counter party risk, issue risk, cash flow analysis and so on.  
  
At FactEntry, we recognize that information and data is key to better risk management. If you are an investment bank, asset manager or a hedge fund looking for an easier way to access data, FactEntry has a solution waiting for you. Our API feeds are developed for easy integration and we offer a mapping service to normalise the data.

About Loretta Swit

Loretta Swit is an iconic American television actress, best known for her role as Major Margaret "Hot Lips" Houlihan in the long-running series, M\*A\*S\*H. Born on November 4, 1937, in Passaic, New Jersey, Swit began her acting career in the theater before transitioning to television, where she became a household name. With her captivating performances and distinct personality, Swit left an indelible mark on audiences around the world.  
  
Swit's journey to stardom began when she discovered her passion for acting at a young age. After graduating from the American Academy of Dramatic Arts in 1960, she made her theatrical debut in the off-Broadway production of The Balcony. Her talent and dedication garnered critical acclaim, leading her to be cast in numerous Broadway productions, including Same Time, Next Year, The Mystery of Edwin Drood, and The Three Sisters. Swit's work in theater laid a solid foundation for her career, honing her skills and preparing her for the success that awaited her on television.  
  
In 1972, Swit's life would change forever when she earned the role of Major Margaret "Hot Lips" Houlihan in the hit television series M\*A\*S\*H. Set during the Korean War, the show follows the lives of the medical personnel stationed at a mobile army surgical hospital. Swit's portrayal of the determined and feisty Margaret earned her critical acclaim and widespread recognition. She brought depth and complexity to the character, showcasing Margaret's growth from a strict disciplinarian to a compassionate and empathetic woman. Swit's chemistry with her fellow cast members, particularly Alan Alda, who played Captain Hawkeye Pierce, contributed to the show's enormous success and popularity.  
  
During her eleven-season stint on M\*A\*S\*H, Swit earned two Emmy Awards for Outstanding Supporting Actress in a Comedy Series. Her performances were universally praised for their emotional depth and comedic timing, often stealing scenes with her sharp wit and undeniable charisma. Swit's portrayal of Margaret transcended the stereotype of women in the military, giving audiences a multifaceted and relatable character.  
  
Beyond M\*A\*S\*H, Swit continued to impress with her versatility, appearing in a wide range of television shows and made-for-television movies. She showcased her dramatic prowess in movies such as The Execution of Private Slovik and The Women's Room. Additionally, she displayed her comedic talents in series like Diagnosis: Murder and Love, American Style. Swit's ability to seamlessly transition between genres highlighted her undeniable talent as an actress.  
  
Swit's impact extended far beyond her acting abilities. Throughout her career, she demonstrated a deep commitment to various philanthropic causes, including animal rights and veterans' issues. She wrote and co-authored several books, including the best-selling SwitHeart: The Watercolour Artistry & Animal Activism of Loretta Swit, in which she shares her passion for art and love for animals. Swit's activism and compassion have made her a beloved figure both on and off-screen.  
  
Now in her later years, Swit continues to inspire and entertain audiences with her undeniable talent and unwavering dedication. Her contributions to television and her advocacy work have solidified her status as an American television legend. Swit's remarkable performances, particularly as Margaret "Hot Lips" Houlihan, continue to captivate audiences, reminding us of the power of exceptional storytelling and the lasting impact of a talented and passionate actress.  
  
In summary, Loretta Swit is an iconic American television actress known for her role as Major Margaret "Hot Lips" Houlihan in the hit series, M\*A\*S\*H. With her captivating performances, Swit left a lasting impression on audiences around the world. About Opening Ceremony
----------------------

Opening Ceremony was founded in 2002 by two friends from UC Berkeley, Carol Lim and Humberto Leon, as a place to share their passions for travel, art, and fashion. Inspired by a trip to Hong Kong, the two decided to leave their jobs in corporate fashion to realize their unique dream. What began as a single store on a quiet street in downtown New York is now a global community with outposts in New York, London, and Los Angeles, a department store in Tokyo, a wholesale showroom, an in-house clothing line, a blog, an e-commerce site, a TV channel, and an annual magazine.  
  
Taking its name and mission statement from the modern Olympic Games, founded by Baron Pierre de Coubertin, Opening Ceremony adopts a multinational approach to retail. In addition to stocking both iconic and emerging homegrown designers, every year OC showcases the spirit and merchandise of a visiting country, transforming each store into a marketplace for exotic souvenirs and international talent.  
  
Over the years, Opening Ceremony has collaborated with brands including Rodarte, Topshop, Pendleton, and Maison Martin Margiela, and has become known for its projects with creatives like Spike Jonze, Terence Koh, and Chloë Sevigny.  
  
For all career opportunities at Opening Ceremony, please visit: http://openingceremony.com/careers

When it comes to getting value for everyday items for the entire family in an easy to shop, neighborhood location, Family Dollar is the best place to go. One of the nation’s fastest growing retailers, Family Dollar offers a compelling assortment of merchandise for the whole family ranging from household cleaners to name brand foods, from health and beauty aids to toys, from apparel for every age to home fashions, all for everyday low prices. While shoppers can find many items at $1 or less, most items in the store are priced below $10, which makes shopping fun without stretching the family budget.  
  
As shoppers enter their neighborhood Family Dollar, they’ll find great values on the name brands they trust in a clean, well-organized store staffed with friendly team members who are members of the local community. The average size of a Family Dollar store is approximately 7,000 square feet, and most stores are operated in leased facilities. This relatively small footprint allows the Company to open new stores in rural areas and small town, as well as in large urban neighborhoods. Within these markets, the stores are located in shopping centers or as free-standing building and all are convenient to the Company’s customer base.  
  
Family Dollar offers a compelling mix of merchandise for the whole family. About Harvey Keitel

Harvey Keitel is one of the most talented and respected American actors of his generation. Known for his intense and charismatic performances, Keitel has effortlessly portrayed a wide range of characters throughout his career, leaving an indelible mark on both the big and small screens. With a career spanning over five decades, he has collaborated with some of the most influential filmmakers in cinema history, earning critical acclaim and numerous accolades for his versatile and memorable portrayals.  
  
Born on May 13, 1939, in Brooklyn, New York, Keitel grew up in a modest Jewish family. As a young man, he struggled to find his place, working various odd jobs, including as a court stenographer, before enlisting in the United States Marine Corps. After his military service, he gravitated towards acting, studying at the HB Studio in New York City and honing his craft in Off-Broadway productions.  
  
Keitel's breakthrough came when he caught the attention of filmmaker Martin Scorsese. The duo first collaborated on the gritty crime drama "Who's That Knocking at My Door" (1967), which marked the beginning of a long and fruitful partnership. Keitel's raw and authentic portrayal of troubled characters resonated with audiences and established him as a formidable force in American cinema.  
  
One of Keitel's most iconic roles came in Scorsese's 1973 classic "Mean Streets." Playing the conflicted and morally ambiguous Charlie, Keitel delivered a powerhouse performance that showcased his ability to bring depth and complexity to his characters. This film marked the beginning of his association with independent cinema, a genre that would later become synonymous with his career.  
  
Keitel continued to captivate audiences in various acclaimed roles throughout the 1970s and 1980s. Notable films during this period include "Taxi Driver" (1976), where he portrayed a pimp named Sport, and "Raging Bull" (1980), where he played the brother of Jake LaMotta, a role that earned him critical praise and cemented his status as a character actor of exceptional talent.  
  
Despite these notable successes, Keitel's career experienced a slight downturn in the late 1980s and early 1990s. However, he bounced back in a big way with his portrayal of the iconic character Winston "The Wolf" Wolfe in Quentin Tarantino's cult classic "Pulp Fiction" (1994). His brief but memorable appearance and his effortless coolness rejuvenated his career, leading to a resurgence in demand for his unique talent.  
  
Throughout the late 1990s and early 2000s, Keitel cemented his reputation as a reliable and versatile actor. Known for his willingness to take on challenging and unconventional roles, he worked with respected directors such as Abel Ferrara, Jane Campion, and Wes Anderson, continuously delivering exceptional performances.  
  
In recent years, Keitel has diversified his filmography, showcasing his versatility by taking on a wide variety of roles. He brilliantly played a World War II veteran struggling with PTSD in "The Grand Budapest Hotel" (2014), a conflicted police detective in the critically acclaimed television series "True Detective" (2015), and a mobster in "The Irishman" (2019), directed by his old collaborator Martin Scorsese.  
  
Beyond his film career, Harvey Keitel has also ventured into other artistic pursuits. He has served as the Executive Producer for several films, including "Three Seasons" (1999) and "The Grey Zone" (2001). Additionally, he has collaborated on various theater productions, demonstrating his commitment to the arts and his desire to continually challenge himself as an artist.  
  
Throughout his illustrious career, Keitel has been recognized for his outstanding talent and contribution to the world of acting. He has received several prestigious awards, including an Academy Award nomination for Best Supporting Actor for his role in "Bugsy" (1991) and a Golden Globe Award for Best Supporting Actor for "Bugsy" and "The Piano" (1993). Keitel's impact is not limited to awards and recognition; his body of work has left an enduring legacy on the film industry.  
  
In conclusion, Harvey Keitel's career is a testament to his remarkable talent and ability to breathe life into unforgettable characters. With his intense performances, unwavering dedication to his craft, and collaborations with cinematic greats, he has proved himself to be a force to be reckoned with in the world of acting. As years go by, Keitel continues to captivate audiences with his dynamic range, leaving an indelible mark on the history of American cinema.

About Badoo
-----------

Date honestly  
  
In April 2006, Andrey Andreev launched Badoo as the first free dating site that combined photo albums with instant messaging. During this time, most dating platforms required paid memberships and had limited photo or messaging support. In 2007, Badoo introduced “Encounters” where users could vote yes or no on cards of other users The site quickly became popular through word of mouth in markets like Spain, France, Italy, Brazil, and Turkey.  
  
In 2009, Badoo innovated premium features and services that are still industry standard within the world of dating and social network. During this time, Badoo introduced features like virtual gifts, the ability to “rise up” in the search results or ability to see “who likes you”. These early innovations enabled Badoo to run a profitable business from its earliest years.  
  
In 2010, Badoo launched and scaled the first modern mobile dating apps on iOS and Android that leveraged GPS technology with its new feature “People Nearby”, which allowed users to see other people in their surrounding area. This enabled users to find people to meet as they were out and about in the world. The mass adoption of this feature enabled Badoo to define the modern mobile era of dating as we know it today.  
  
The technology of Badoo became the backbone of MagicLab’s shared infrastructure, which is now leveraged across MagicLab’s family of brands like Bumble, Chappy, Lumen, and more to come. Through MagicLab’s efforts, Badoo has been able to launch features like photo verification to eliminate catfishing from the service.  
  
Badoo today is a community of over 425 million people representing people of all pasts and backgrounds. Badoo has some of the richest interactions in the industry, including features like video chat, live-streaming, rich messaging, and more. In 2019, the brand relaunched around the tagline “Date honestly” as the platform that enables people to authentically express who they are and what they really want.

We are a nonprofit corporation focused on youth development, educational consultation, scholarship management, and college preparation. We aid youth in the development of tactical methods to overcome personal hardships; and to enhance their leadership qualities, basic life skills, and methods to communicate and network. We encourage youth to understand and utilize both positive and negative experiences for personal development. Continuously, we conduct research in the areas of education, communication, relationships, socioeconomic issues, childcare, and health and wellness. We foster youth development through education, training initiatives, and exposure opportunities.  
  
We operate based on the foundational understanding that youth face significant effects of socioeconomic issues that influence their inability and unwillingness to achieve an education; extreme usage of illegal drugs and heavy underage drinking; and risky and irresponsible sexual behavior. Many urban students are affected by poverty and living in single-parent homes, which is a major factor in their growth and development. There are youth who have the ability to understand basic concepts of life, truth, which references to history, spiritual concepts, morals and values, and the influential effects of irresponsible sexual behavior.  
  
Young A.D.U.L.T.S. exemplifies the organization and effectiveness mature youth and young adults have in making a difference in their communities.

About National Science Foundation (NSF)
---------------------------------------

The National Science Foundation (NSF) is an independent federal agency created by Congress in 1950 "to promote the progress of science; to advance the national health, prosperity, and welfare; to secure the national defense…" With an annual budget of more than $8 billion, NSF is the funding source for approximately 20 percent of all federally supported basic research conducted by America’s colleges and universities. In many fields such as mathematics, computer science and the social sciences, NSF is the major source of federal backing.  
  
NSF awards about 11,000 new awards per year, with an average duration of three years -- to fund specific research proposals that have been judged the most promising by a rigorous and objective merit-review system. In the past few decades, NSF-funded researchers have won more than 200 Nobel Prizes as well as other honors too numerous to list. NSF funds equipment that is needed by scientists and engineers but is often too expensive for any one group or researcher to afford. Another essential element in NSF's mission is support for science and engineering education, from pre-K through graduate school and beyond.  
  
There are many exciting careers at NSF, not only in science, technology, education and mathematics (STEM), but also in business and operations. For more information, please visit us at http://nsf.gov/careers/.  
  
NSF welcomes opportunities to engage with you on our LinkedIn page. Please see our Comment Policy \[http://www.nsf.gov/social/policies.jsp \] for more information.

What types of IT solutions does Daybreak IT Solutions offer?

Daybreak IT Solutions provides a comprehensive range of IT solutions including managed IT services, cloud computing, cybersecurity, data backup and recovery, and IT consulting. Their managed services help businesses optimize their IT infrastructure, while their cloud solutions enable scalable and flexible computing options. Cybersecurity services are designed to protect sensitive data, and their data backup and recovery solutions ensure business continuity in case of data loss.

Which industries does Daybreak IT Solutions serve?

Daybreak IT Solutions serves a variety of industries including healthcare, finance, education, manufacturing, and retail. Each industry has unique IT needs, and Daybreak tailors its solutions to meet those specific requirements. Daybreak IT Solutions employs a multi-layered approach to data security, which includes advanced firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and regular security audits. The onboarding process at Daybreak IT Solutions begins with an initial consultation to understand the client's specific needs and challenges. Daybreak ensures that the transition is smooth and that clients are fully supported throughout the process.

Can Daybreak IT Solutions assist with cloud migration?

Yes, Daybreak IT Solutions specializes in cloud migration services. They help businesses transition from on-premises infrastructure to cloud-based solutions by assessing the current environment, selecting the right cloud platform, and executing a detailed migration plan. Their team ensures minimal disruption during the migration process and provides ongoing support to optimize cloud usage post-migration.

What support options does Daybreak IT Solutions provide for ongoing IT management?

Daybreak IT Solutions offers various support options for ongoing IT management, including 24/7 help desk support, on-site technical assistance, and remote monitoring services. About Cardiovascular Research Foundation
----------------------------------------

The Cardiovascular Research Foundation (CRF) is one of the world’s leading nonprofit organizations specializing in interventional cardiology innovation, research, and education. CRF is dedicated to helping doctors improve survival and quality of life for people with heart and vascular disease. For over 30 years, CRF has helped accelerate medical breakthroughs and educated doctors on the latest treatments for heart disease.  
  
CRF works to identify, develop and promote the latest advancements in the treatment of heart and vascular disease. By covering all aspects of the research continuum, we’re able to accelerate the speed at which breakthrough therapies reach patients through doctors, improving survival rates and quality of life for patients worldwide.  
  
Our Divisions  
  
The CRF Skirball Center for Innovation guides early ideas and innovations through comprehensive preclinical research programs to introduce practical clinical therapies to patients.  
  
The CRF Clinical Trials Center plans and executes clinical investigations from first-in-man studies to large, multicenter, international trials and provides expert, independent qualitative and quantitative analyses of clinical and imaging data.  
  
The CRF Center for Education delivers world-class education and training for the interventional cardiovascular team at more than 50 meetings and conferences each year, including the annual Transcatheter Cardiovascular Therapeutics (TCT®) scientific symposium.  
  
CRF Digital expands access to our educational programming by harnessing the power of digital platforms to further the practice of interventional cardiovascular medicine. The centerpiece of CRF Digital is TCTMD, the most comprehensive online news source in interventional cardiology and provides in-depth coverage across the spectrum of cardiovascular disease research and practice.  
  
CRF is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization.

It was only natural for Jarrett to follow in their footsteps, and he did so with great success.  
  
Jarrett’s career began in the early 1980s when he started training in his father’s wrestling promotion, the Continental Wrestling Association (CWA). He quickly honed his skills and made his professional debut in 1986 at the tender age of 19. It was immediately clear that Jarrett possessed the athleticism, technical prowess, and showmanship required to excel in the squared circle.  
  
Jarrett’s early career saw him compete in various promotions, including WCCW and Memphis Wrestling. He gained valuable experience and started to build a solid reputation among wrestling fans. In 1992, he made his debut in the World Wrestling Federation (now known as WWE), which propelled him into the national spotlight.  
  
Throughout his numerous stints with WWE, Jarrett showcased his wrestling ability while also developing his on-camera persona. Known as "Double J," he quickly established himself as a charismatic, cocky villain who was always ready to cheat his way to victory. This persona resonated with audiences and helped him become one of the promotion's top heels.  
  
In 1995, Jarrett made a career-defining move by joining World Championship Wrestling (WCW), another major wrestling promotion. The nWo became one of the most iconic and influential factions in wrestling history, and Jarrett’s involvement further solidified his status as a top-level talent.  
  
Jarrett’s undeniable talent led to his eventual return to WWE in 1997. As the co-founder of TNA, Jarrett became an essential figure in the wrestling world, not just as an in-ring performer but also as a promoter. Under his guidance, TNA grew from a small independent promotion to a legitimate alternative to the WWE, consistently featuring high-quality matches and storylines.  
  
Jarrett’s passion for the business and his hands-on approach to promoting the sport became evident during his time with TNA. He negotiated television deals, signed talented wrestlers, and implemented innovative concepts that resonated with fans. Jarrett’s vision and dedication played a significant role in TNA's success, ensuring its longevity and relevance.  
  
In recent years, Jarrett has continued to achieve new milestones in his storied career. In 2018, he made a surprise return to WWE, becoming an inductee of the WWE Hall of Fame. This acknowledgment from his peers and fans solidified his status as one of the industry's most influential figures and underlined the respect he commands.  
  
Today, Jarrett remains an active presence in the wrestling world, both in front of the camera and behind the scenes. Ahsanullah University of Science and Technology (AUST), located in the Tejgaon Industrial Area of Dhaka, Bangladesh, is a premier private technical university established in 1995 by the Dhaka Ahsania Mission, a renowned non-profit organization founded in 1958 by Khan Bahadur Ahsanullah. AUST is dedicated to providing high-quality education in various fields of science, technology, and management, fostering a culture of innovation and research. The Faculty of Business and Social Science provides comprehensive business education through its School of Business, offering Bachelor and Master of Business Administration degrees. Additionally, the Faculty of Education focuses on developing future educators with programs in Primary and Non-Formal Education, as well as a Master of Education.  
  
For those interested in the academic staff, the Ahsanullah University Of Science And Technology teachers list showcases a team of dedicated professionals committed to nurturing the next generation of leaders and innovators. MIA is the first Italian market converging all the segments of the audiovisual industry (Film | Drama Series | Doc | Animation). With over 2000 professionals from 58 countries participating to each edition, MIA is a valuable platform for the top players of the national and international film industry such as producers and distributors of high-end content: a hub where theatrical deals and transnational TV series start, and a place where to establish and reinforce business relationships between global market leaders.  
  
MIA I Mercato Internazionale Audiovisivo is a brand and a project created and produced by ANICA (National Association of Cinema and Audiovisual Industries) and APA (Association of Audiovisual Producers), MIA is supported by the Ministry for Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation, ICE (Italian Trade Agency for the global promotion and Internationalization of Italian companies), the Ministry for Cultural Heritage and Activities and Tourism, the Ministry of Economic Development, Lazio Region, MEDIA Programme of the European Union. About Kate Hudson

Kate Hudson - An American Actress taking Hollywood by Storm  
  
Kate Hudson, the multi-talented American actress, has captured the hearts of audiences worldwide with her undeniable charm and stunning performances. With an ethereal beauty, infectious energy, and undeniable talent, Hudson has become one of the most sought-after stars in Hollywood. Born on April 19, 1979, in Los Angeles, California, Kate Garry Hudson was destined for greatness.  
  
Hudson was born into Hollywood royalty, as the daughter of versatile actress Goldie Hawn and musician Bill Hudson. Growing up in an environment immersed in creativity, it came as no surprise when Hudson decided to follow in her mother's footsteps and pursue a career in acting. However, she successfully carved out her own path and established herself as a force to be reckoned with in the entertainment industry.  
  
Hudson’s breakthrough role came in the now-iconic film, "Almost Famous," directed by Cameron Crowe. Released in 2000, the movie captivated audiences with its nostalgic portrayal of the 1970s music scene. Hudson's portrayal of the free-spirited groupie, Penny Lane, earned her widespread acclaim and catapulted her into stardom. Her performance was a testament to her versatility as an actress, effortlessly blending vulnerability, wit, and magnetic charisma.  
  
Following her breakout role, Hudson proved that she was no one-hit wonder. She went on to deliver a string of powerful performances in movies such as "How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days," where she showcased her comedic timing alongside Matthew McConaughey. The film was an instant success, solidifying Hudson's status as a leading lady in romantic comedies. Her relatable and charismatic on-screen presence resonated with audiences, making her a beloved figure in the genre.  
  
In 2009, Hudson demonstrated her dramatic range with an Academy Award-nominated performance in "Nine." Directed by Rob Marshall, the film showcased her exceptional singing and dancing abilities, revealing yet another layer of her remarkable talent. Hudson's portrayal of Stephanie Necrophorous received critical acclaim, further cementing her status as a versatile actress who could excel in any genre.  
  
Beyond her exceptional acting abilities, Hudson is also an entrepreneur and role model. In 2013, she co-founded Fabletics, a highly successful athleisure brand. The company quickly gained popularity for its inclusive size range and commitment to sustainability. Hudson's involvement in Fabletics not only showcased her business acumen but also highlighted her dedication to empowering women of all shapes and sizes.

She captivated audiences with her magnetic performances in a wide range of genres, from period dramas to romantic comedies and psychological thrillers. In the 2000 film "Quills," Winslet delivered a powerful portrayal of a laundress who becomes involved in the life of the infamous Marquis de Sade. Her raw and emotionally charged performance earned her an Academy Award nomination for Best Supporting Actress, solidifying her reputation as one of Hollywood's most talented actresses.  
  
Continuing her streak of remarkable performances, Winslet starred alongside Jim Carrey in Michel Gondry's critically acclaimed film "Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind" in 2004. Her portrayal of Clementine Kruczynski, a free-spirited woman who decides to have her memories of a failed relationship erased, showcased her extraordinary range as an actress. Winslet effortlessly transitioned from moments of vulnerability to moments of great strength, earning her a second Academy Award nomination, this time for Best Actress.  
  
In 2008, Winslet's stellar career reached new heights when she won the Academy Award for Best Actress for her role in Stephen Daldry's "The Reader." In this emotionally gripping film, she played Hanna Schmitz, a former Nazi prison guard who becomes involved in a complicated relationship with a young man. Winslet's portrayal of Hanna was profoundly nuanced and compelling, demonstrating her fearlessness in taking on complex and morally ambiguous characters. Her poignant performance in "The Reader" not only earned her the highest recognition in the industry but also solidified her status as a leading actress of her generation.  
  
Despite achieving unparalleled success in her career, Kate Winslet remains grounded and committed to her craft. Known for her professionalism and dedication to her roles, she has consistently sought out projects that push boundaries and challenge societal norms. She has never shied away from difficult or controversial subject matters, instead using her platform to bring light to important stories that would have otherwise gone untold.  
  
Beyond being a remarkable actress, Winslet has also become an inspiration to many women around the world. Her refusal to conform to the industry's standards of beauty and her unwavering commitment to being true to herself have made her a role model for body positivity. In a society that often places unrealistic expectations on women's appearances, Winslet has been a vocal advocate for self-acceptance and has consistently championed the idea that beauty comes in all shapes and sizes.  
  
In conclusion, Kate Winslet's incredible talent, versatility, and commitment to her craft have solidified her status as one of the most respected and acclaimed actresses of her generation. From her breakout role in "Titanic" to her award-winning performances in "Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind" and "The Reader," Winslet has captivated audiences and critics alike with her remarkable range and ability to bring complex characters to life. Moreover, her fearlessness in choosing roles and her dedication to creating meaningful stories on-screen make her an inspiration to aspiring actors and actresses everywhere. With each new project, Winslet continues to raise the bar for excellence in acting, leaving audiences eagerly anticipating her next captivating performance.

What services does AmbioPharm offer as a peptide CDMO?

AmbioPharm specializes in a wide range of services as a Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) for peptides. Their offerings include process development, GMP peptide manufacturing, regulatory support, and analytical methods support. They cater to various industries, including pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, and agriculture, providing custom peptide synthesis, generic peptides, and peptide active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) for clinical and preclinical applications.

What is the significance of GMP in peptide manufacturing at AmbioPharm?

GMP, or Good Manufacturing Practice, is crucial in the pharmaceutical industry to ensure that products are consistently produced and controlled according to quality standards. At AmbioPharm, GMP compliance guarantees that their peptide manufacturing processes meet regulatory requirements, ensuring the safety, efficacy, and quality of peptide-based APIs. This is particularly important for clients developing peptides for clinical trials and commercial use.

Can AmbioPharm assist with regulatory support for peptide products?

Yes, AmbioPharm provides comprehensive regulatory support for peptide products. Their team is experienced in navigating the complex regulatory landscape, helping clients prepare the necessary documentation for submissions to regulatory agencies. This includes guidance on compliance with FDA regulations and other international standards, ensuring that clients can successfully bring their peptide products to market.

What types of peptides can AmbioPharm manufacture?

AmbioPharm is capable of manufacturing a wide variety of peptides, including custom peptides, generic peptides, and peptide APIs for new chemical entities (NCEs). They also produce cosmetic peptides and agricultural peptides. Their expertise spans across different applications, from clinical and preclinical manufacturing to commercial peptide production, allowing them to meet diverse client needs.

How does AmbioPharm ensure the quality of its peptide products?

AmbioPharm employs rigorous quality control measures throughout the peptide manufacturing process. This includes the use of validated analytical methods to test the purity, identity, and potency of the peptides produced. Their adherence to GMP guidelines and continuous monitoring of manufacturing processes further ensure that the peptides meet the highest quality standards required for pharmaceutical and other applications.

What industries does AmbioPharm serve?

AmbioPharm serves a variety of industries, including pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, and agriculture. They provide tailored peptide solutions for each sector, whether it’s developing peptide APIs for drug development, creating cosmetic peptides for skincare products, or synthesizing agricultural peptides for crop protection. Their broad expertise allows them to support clients across multiple fields with specialized peptide manufacturing and development services.

As Senior Corporate Counsel for Cloud and Artificial Intelligence at Microsoft, Benjamin Rickert plays a pivotal role in navigating the complex legal landscape of emerging technologies. His extensive experience in privacy law, telecommunications, and accessibility positions him as a key advisor in ensuring compliance and fostering innovation within these dynamic sectors.  
  
Benjamin's expertise in intellectual property and software licensing is particularly valuable in the fast-paced environment of cloud computing and AI development. He adeptly manages contract negotiations, ensuring that Microsoft’s strategic partnerships are legally sound while promoting growth and collaboration. His passion for working in rapid-software release environments allows him to effectively address the legal challenges that arise in the development of consumer products, ensuring that they meet both regulatory requirements and user expectations for privacy and online safety.  
  
In addition to his legal acumen, Benjamin is committed to promoting accessibility in technology, advocating for inclusive design principles that enhance user experience across diverse demographics. His role not only involves mitigating risks but also driving initiatives that align with Microsoft’s mission to empower every person and organization on the planet. Through his leadership and strategic insights, Benjamin Rickert is instrumental in shaping the future of Microsoft’s cloud and AI offerings while upholding the highest standards of legal integrity.

About Guangzhou Duoyi Network Inc.
----------------------------------

广州多益网络科技有限公司（以下简称：多益网络），是中国领先的互联网企业，于2014年位列中国互联网企业百强第27位。多益网络在广州、成都两地设有公司。  
  
多益网络专注自主研发和运营，80%员工为研发人员，旗下业务涵盖PC端网络游戏、手游、电子邮箱、IM等各类软件和各类移动互联网产品。跻身国内八大网游研发商和运营商的多益网络，收入连续三年双位数增长。  
  
2007年9月，多益网络正式推出首款产品《梦想世界》，随后接连推出了《神武》等多款不同类型的游戏产品。《梦想世界》、《神武》连续大成，《神武》更被誉为国民级网游，成为新一代优秀网游的代表之作。  
  
在移动互联网领域，从2010年《梦想帝王》iPhone版发布开始，多益网络先后推出领爱、2980邮箱等多种类型的移动互联网产品。2011年8月，休闲竞技游戏《坦克部队！》上线，取得了Appstore免费榜冠军的成绩。2014年8月，国民回合《神武》手游面世，引领了中国手游行业网游化的新趋势，并获得App Store畅销总榜冠军。  
  
“虚拟的游戏，真实的幸福”，多益网络将继续秉承这样的理念，通过自身用心、踏实的努力为互联网用户提供更多姿多彩的娱乐生活。

Phil Collins - Singer and Drummer Extraordinaire  
  
Phil Collins is an iconic English musician known for his mesmerizing singing abilities and remarkable drumming skills. With a career spanning over five decades, Collins has left an indelible mark on the music industry as a solo artist, lead vocalist of Genesis, and as a session musician. His unique blend of soulful voice, heartfelt lyrics, and impeccable timing on the drums have captivated audiences worldwide and earned him an esteemed place among music legends.  
  
Born on January 30, 1951, in Chiswick, London, Collins initially found success as a drummer before his talents as a singer came to the forefront. In his early career, the talented musician played drums for various jazz and rock bands, honing his skills and earning recognition for his technical prowess. It was during this period that he developed a deep appreciation for rhythm and learned to incorporate it seamlessly into his singing style.  
  
Collins's breakthrough moment came in 1970 when he joined the rock band Genesis as their drummer. Blessed with both technical proficiency and a keen sense of musicality, he quickly became an integral part of the band's sound. As Genesis evolved from a progressive rock outfit to a more commercially successful pop-rock group, Collins's influence grew significantly. He not only contributed to the compositions but also lent his voice on a few tracks, hinting at the vocal prowess that would define his future solo career.  
  
In 1975, Genesis released the album "The Lamb Lies Down on Broadway," which showcased Collins's growing vocal role in the band. By the late 1970s, he had established himself as the lead vocalist of Genesis, seamlessly transitioning between his drum kit and the microphone. This dual role allowed Collins to express his musicality fully, using his drums to create complex rhythms while his soulful voice brought emotional depth to the lyrics.  
  
In the early 1980s, Collins embarked on a flourishing solo career alongside his commitments with Genesis. Combining his soulful voice with catchy pop melodies, he produced a string of chart-topping hits that showcased his range as an artist. Tracks like "In the Air Tonight," "Against All Odds (Take a Look at Me Now)," and "Another Day in Paradise" became signature songs of his solo career, resonating with millions of fans worldwide. Collins's ability to infuse emotion into his distinct voice, combined with his heartfelt lyrics, made him an icon of romantic ballads and propelled him into the pantheon of pop music superstars.  
  
While Collins soared to new heights in his solo career, his contributions to Genesis remained invaluable. The band delivered several critically acclaimed albums, including "Duke," "Abacab," and "Invisible Touch." Collins's unique style of drumming added layers of complexity to the group's music, and his vocal contributions further enriched their sound. This remarkable synergy and collaboration between Collins and the other members of Genesis solidified their status as one of the most enduring and influential bands of the era.  
  
Throughout his career, Collins has collaborated with numerous renowned musicians, including Eric Clapton, Paul McCartney, and Robert Plant, further exemplifying his versatility and artistic brilliance. His ability to adapt to various musical genres, ranging from rock and pop to jazz and soul, showcases his skills as a multi-talented musician. Collins's distinctive voice, characterized by its raw emotions and soulful delivery, fused with his impeccable sense of timing on the drums, has left an indelible mark on generations of music lovers.  
  
Despite some health setbacks that limited his performances in recent years, Collins's legacy as a singer and drummer remains an undeniable force in the music industry. His influence can be seen in countless artists who have sought to blend their vocal talents with rhythmic expertise. Phil Collins redefined the role of a drummer by not only providing the backbone to countless songs but also stepping into the spotlight and captivating audiences with his distinctive voice. His awe-inspiring talent and knack for storytelling have made him a true legend whose music continues to resonate with fans around the world.

What services does The Mortgage Collaborative offer to mortgage lenders?

The Mortgage Collaborative provides a range of services designed to empower mortgage lenders, including financial execution strategies, cost reduction techniques, compliance support, and access to industry expertise. By leveraging a cooperative model, members can share resources, best practices, and insights to enhance their operational efficiency and competitiveness in the mortgage lending market.

How can joining The Mortgage Collaborative benefit my mortgage lending business?

Joining The Mortgage Collaborative offers numerous benefits, including access to a vast network of industry professionals, collaborative opportunities for sharing knowledge and resources, and tailored solutions that address the unique challenges faced by mortgage lenders. Members can also participate in educational programs, gain insights into market trends, and leverage collective buying power to reduce costs.

What types of mortgage lenders can benefit from The Mortgage Collaborative's services?

The Mortgage Collaborative supports a diverse range of mortgage lenders, including community banks, credit unions, independent mortgage banks, and larger financial institutions. Whether you are a small lender looking to enhance your operational capabilities or a larger institution seeking to streamline processes and improve compliance, The Mortgage Collaborative offers tailored solutions to meet your specific needs.

Does The Mortgage Collaborative provide training or educational resources for its members?

Yes, The Mortgage Collaborative offers a variety of training and educational resources for its members. This includes webinars, workshops, and access to industry experts who provide insights on best practices, regulatory changes, and market trends. These resources are designed to help members stay informed and enhance their operational effectiveness in the ever-evolving mortgage landscape.

How does The Mortgage Collaborative ensure compliance for its members?

The Mortgage Collaborative provides compliance support through a combination of expert guidance, resources, and tools designed to help members navigate the complex regulatory landscape of mortgage lending. This includes access to compliance training, updates on regulatory changes, and best practices for maintaining compliance, ensuring that members can operate confidently and effectively within the legal framework.

What networking opportunities are available through The Mortgage Collaborative?

The Mortgage Collaborative offers extensive networking opportunities for its members, including industry conferences, regional meetings, and online forums. These events allow members to connect with peers, share insights, and build relationships that can lead to collaborative opportunities and partnerships. Networking is a key component of The Mortgage Collaborative's mission to empower lenders through shared knowledge and resources.

About Beth Whisman

Beth Whisman serves as the Director of the Cultural Arts Department and the Children’s Discovery Museum for the Town of Normal, IL, where her leadership has significantly elevated the cultural landscape of the community. With a robust annual budget of $2.8 million, Beth expertly manages a diverse portfolio that includes the Children’s Discovery Museum, which attracts approximately 140,000 visitors each year, as well as the historic Normal Theater and various public events, concerts, and festivals. Her strategic vision has led to the successful funding of three new exhibits, enhancing the museum's offerings and educational impact, while also revitalizing the Foundation Board during her first three years in the role.  
  
Beth's expertise in nonprofit management is complemented by her training at the Lilly Family School of Philanthropy at Indiana University-Purdue University Indianapolis, equipping her with the skills necessary for effective fundraising and community engagement. Over her tenure, she has secured more than $1 million in grants and donations, demonstrating her proficiency in building relationships with stakeholders and advocating for the arts. Her background as an award-winning radio news director and reporter enriches her communication skills, allowing her to engage the public through compelling storytelling and effective marketing strategies.  
  
In addition to her financial acumen and project management capabilities, Beth is a passionate advocate for cultural development, utilizing her skills in public speaking, journalism, and writing to promote the arts within the community. Her commitment to fostering creativity and learning through the arts positions her as a pivotal figure in Normal's cultural sector, inspiring both residents and visitors alike.

About Jennifer Young

As the Co-founder and Chief Marketing Officer of Outdoorsy, Jennifer Young is at the forefront of revolutionizing the outdoor travel industry. With a commitment to building a lovable outdoor travel brand, she leverages her extensive expertise in digital marketing, brand development, and strategic planning to create a marketplace that connects adventure seekers with unforgettable experiences in nature. Under her leadership, Outdoorsy has grown into a thriving platform that not only facilitates memorable journeys but also prioritizes safety through innovative insuretech solutions.  
  
Jennifer's passion for product-market fit drives her to continuously refine the customer experience, ensuring that every interaction resonates with authenticity and fosters a deep connection to the outdoors. She believes that nature is an integral part of human nature, and this philosophy is woven into the fabric of Outdoorsy’s mission to restore relationships with both the environment and fellow travelers. Key projects under her direction include the development of user-friendly e-commerce solutions and robust customer relationship management systems that enhance user engagement and satisfaction.  
  
In addition to her strategic vision, Jennifer's results-driven approach emphasizes growth and profitability, making her a pivotal figure in the start-up landscape. Her ability to navigate the complexities of new business development while maintaining a focus on creative direction has positioned Outdoorsy as a leader in the outdoor travel market. As she continues to champion the brand's values, Jennifer remains dedicated to inspiring others to explore the great outdoors, fostering a community that celebrates adventure, safety, and connection.

About Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center
------------------------------------------

Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center (BIDMC), located at 330 Brookline Ave, Boston, MA, is a premier academic medical center and a vital part of the Beth Israel Lahey Health system. This innovative healthcare network unites a diverse array of facilities, including academic medical centers, community hospitals, and specialty care providers, all dedicated to enhancing patient access to exceptional healthcare services. As a world-class teaching hospital affiliated with Harvard Medical School, BIDMC is at the forefront of medical education, research, and patient care.  
  
BIDMC offers a comprehensive range of services across various specialties, including cardiology, oncology, neurology, and orthopedics, among others. The center is committed to utilizing cutting-edge technologies and advanced medical practices to deliver high-quality care. With a focus on patient-centered medicine, BIDMC prioritizes the well-being of its patients, treating them with compassion and respect, akin to family. The institution is also deeply invested in groundbreaking research, striving to discover new treatments and cures that can transform lives.  
  
In addition to its clinical services, BIDMC plays a pivotal role in training the next generation of healthcare professionals. The center fosters an environment of learning and innovation, encouraging caregivers to develop their skills and knowledge. For those interested in pursuing a career in this dynamic and impactful environment, BIDMC offers a variety of opportunities, reflecting its commitment to excellence in healthcare. To explore career options, visit www.jobs.bidmc.org. At BIDMC, the mission is clear: to put people first in every aspect of care, research, and education.

What types of medical communications solutions does Springer Healthcare offer?

Springer Healthcare provides a wide range of medical communications solutions, including strategic planning, content development, and execution of medical education programs. Our services are designed to enhance understanding and engagement among healthcare professionals, patients, and stakeholders. We specialize in creating tailored content that meets the specific needs of our clients, ensuring that the information is not only scientifically accurate but also accessible and impactful.

How does Springer Healthcare support medical education?

Springer Healthcare supports medical education through a variety of initiatives, including independent medical education (IME) programs, workshops, and online learning modules. We collaborate with healthcare professionals and organizations to develop educational content that is evidence-based and relevant to current clinical practices. Our goal is to facilitate continuous learning and improve patient outcomes by ensuring that healthcare providers have access to the latest medical knowledge and advancements.

What industries does Springer Healthcare serve?

Springer Healthcare serves a diverse range of industries within the healthcare sector, including pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, medical devices, and healthcare providers. Our expertise allows us to address the unique challenges and needs of each industry, providing customized solutions that enhance communication, education, and engagement across various healthcare stakeholders.

Can Springer Healthcare assist with sales force training?

Yes, Springer Healthcare offers comprehensive sales force training programs tailored to the needs of pharmaceutical and medical device companies. Our training solutions focus on equipping sales representatives with the necessary knowledge and skills to effectively communicate complex medical information to healthcare professionals. We utilize a combination of interactive workshops, e-learning modules, and real-world simulations to ensure that sales teams are well-prepared to engage with their audiences.

What is the process for obtaining reprints of scientific articles published by Springer Healthcare?

To obtain reprints of scientific articles published by Springer Healthcare, you can visit our website and navigate to the reprints section. There, you will find information on how to request reprints, including options for bulk orders and customization. Our team is dedicated to assisting you with your request and ensuring that you receive high-quality printed materials that meet your needs.

How does Springer Healthcare handle society content licensing?

Springer Healthcare offers society content licensing services that allow organizations to leverage high-quality medical content for their own educational and promotional purposes. We work closely with medical societies to ensure that their content is effectively licensed and distributed, providing access to valuable resources that can enhance member engagement and education. Our licensing agreements are designed to be flexible and tailored to the specific needs of each society.

About Barilla Group
-------------------

We are an Italian family-owned food company. And like all Italian families, we take food very seriously. We have been doing this for 147 years. Today we are committed to bringing people closer to the joy of good food and making quality the choice for a better life, from each individual to the planet.  
  
Our origins date back to 1877, when Pietro Barilla opened a small bread and pasta shop in Parma: that moment marked the beginning of a story of passion for quality, continuous pursuit of excellent recipes and ability to combine tradition and innovation.  
Today we are an international Group present in more than 100 countries through our brands: world leader for pasta, leader for ready-made sauces in Europe, for bakery products in Italy and for crispbreads in Scandinavia. We employ over 9,000 people and own 30 production sites in 10 countries which every year contribute to the production of about 2,000,000 tons of products.  
  
We work every day to be the most reputable Italian food company worldwide, bringing to the world tasty, joyful and wholesome products - made with selected raw materials from responsible supply chains - reducing our impact on the planet and fostering open and caring dialogue in the communities in which we operate. This is our commitment to people and the planet we live on and it involves understanding our true essence and sharing it with people; it is the philosophy reflected in our purpose “The joy of food for a better life”.  
  
At Barilla we empower people to live and work responsibly and ethically, embracing our value system of integrity, trust, courage, intellectual curiosity and passion. Moreover, we acknowledge diversity as a key factor to drive our future: that is why our people are invited to bring their authentic self to work and enjoy acceptance and understanding.

About Hello Games
-----------------

We are Hello Games, and we make games. Hello!  
  
We’re a video game development studio and publisher based in Guildford and Cambridge in the UK, and are proudly independent. We are the creators of the multi-award winning Joe Danger games, the huge and evolving No Man’s Sky and a recently announced side project The Last Campfire and when we’re not doing that, we’re probably working on something new.  
  
Team  
  
The people of Hello Games are a varied bunch, but there’s a few things they have in common. Generally they’re humble, they have potential, and the grit to try to do their best work here.  
  
Our team is everything, so if you think you fit, then we are always hiring.  
  
History  
  
We believe that small talented teams can achieve great things. As a team of four in a tiny room above a tile shop, we created the multi million selling Joe Danger. As a dozen developers in a leaking shed, we borrowed our neighbour’s internet and created one of the biggest selling new IPs in video games – No Man’s Sky.  
  
The success of No Man’s Sky has given us a nice office and a whole bunch more freedom to expand creatively. These days we try to join the stability and quality of AAA development with the freedom and creativity of an independent studio. We are excited to bring new games that wouldn’t exist otherwise into the world.

About CEI Construction Estimating Institute
-------------------------------------------

The Construction Estimating Institute (CEI) is a leading provider of construction training and DBE Supportive Services. CEI training courses deliver the essential skills and critical knowledge that you need to be successful in the construction industry. Join the over 100,000 construction professionals who have improved their skills through CEI training. Classes are held on beautiful Siesta Key in Sarasota, Florida and at a variety of locations throughout the United States.  
  
CEI's DBE Supportive Services group has proven to be a leader in the industry. CEI currently provides programs in several states and has been able to take existing DBE programs to the next level. Where there isn't a program CEI can help institute one to help DBEs achieve growth and sustainability. CEI has a complete team to implement any program from web design and capability statements to business plans and estimating projects.  
CEI's bid matching program is cost affordable and easy to use. this program is offered free to DBE's in some states.  
  
CEI offers seminars and courses, private training, and association sponsored training. Construction Estimating Institute also offers Florida Contractors Exam classes and continuing education.  
  
Visit www.ceihome.com for more information.

About Bryant Goulding

As Co-Founder of Rhinegeist Brewery, Bryant Goulding is at the forefront of a brewing renaissance in Cincinnati, leveraging his extensive experience in the craft beer industry to build a modern brewery in a historic setting. With a background that includes consulting for renowned breweries on the West Coast, Bryant has honed his skills in business planning, marketing, and inventory management, which have been instrumental in the successful launch of Rhinegeist. The brewery is situated in a building that once housed the largest pre-Prohibition brewery in the city, providing a unique blend of historical significance and contemporary brewing innovation.  
  
Bryant's journey began with a comprehensive business plan that emphasized financial modeling over poetic flair, ensuring a solid foundation for the venture. His relentless pursuit of excellence led him to research the best practices employed by top breweries across the nation, allowing him to implement proven strategies while infusing his own creative vision. The acquisition of a used brewhouse and the meticulous process of brewing test batches exemplify his hands-on approach and commitment to quality.  
  
In addition to his operational expertise, Bryant excels in event management and social media marketing, effectively engaging the community and enhancing the brewery's brand presence. His ability to forecast trends and analyze market demands positions Rhinegeist as a competitive player in the craft beer landscape. As he continues to build and refine the brewery's offerings, Bryant remains dedicated to creating exceptional experiences for customers, ensuring that Rhinegeist not only honors its storied past but also embraces the future of craft brewing.

Born Daniel Patrick Pugh on May 15, 1956, in Zanesville, Ohio, Patrick's passion for sports was evident from an early age. Raised in a household where athletics played a central role, he pursued his love for the game by excelling in basketball and baseball during his high school years. This dedication paid off when he received a scholarship to play basketball at the prestigious Eastern Kentucky University. Throughout his illustrious career, Dan Patrick has received numerous accolades for his contributions to sports journalism. He has been named National Sportscaster of the Year by the National Sportscasters and Sportswriters Association multiple times, solidifying his reputation as one of the most respected voices in the industry. Patrick's engaging personality, combined with his deep knowledge and passion for sports, has made him a beloved figure to fans worldwide.  
  
In conclusion, Dan Patrick's remarkable career as an American sports commentator and radio personality has spanned over four decades. From his early days as a sports reporter to his current role as the host of "The Dan Patrick Show," Patrick's engaging and insightful style has solidified his place as one of the industry's most influential figures. With his charismatic personality, quick wit, and in-depth knowledge of sports, he has captivated audiences and earned their trust. About Kesete Admasu

Kesete Admasu is the CEO at Big Win Philanthropy, an organization dedicated to creating sustainable and scalable opportunities for children and youth around the world. With a background in public health and a deep understanding of the complexities of global development, Kesete is committed to driving change and impact in the areas of education, health, and economic empowerment.  
  
Having spent over two decades working in the public health sector, Kesete brings a wealth of experience and knowledge to his role at Big Win Philanthropy. He has a strong track record of leading large-scale initiatives and has a deep understanding of the challenges that marginalized communities face. Kesete's unique blend of expertise in public health, development economics, and strategic leadership has enabled him to drive innovative solutions and partnerships that have a lasting impact on the lives of children and youth.  
  
Under Kesete's leadership, Big Win Philanthropy has developed a reputation for investing in transformative initiatives that address the root causes of poverty and inequality. By focusing on long-term, sustainable solutions, the organization is able to create lasting change and opportunity for the next generation. Kesete's commitment to evidence-based approaches and data-driven decision-making ensures that every investment made by Big Win Philanthropy has a measurable impact and delivers tangible results.  
  
One of Kesete's key priorities as CEO is to foster collaboration and partnership with governments, NGOs, and the private sector. About 时代地产控股有限公司 Times Property Holding Limited
-----------------------------------------------

Times Property, established in 1999, enjoys the distinction of being listed in the Fortune China 500 and China's Top 50 Real-Estate Development Enterprises. In addition to such distinctions, it's a listed company on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (stock code 01233.HK). Its business activity mainly comprises the development of residential community projects, commercial facilities and creative office space, all of which is augmented by property-management services. Times Property's total assets exceeded RMB 30 billion as of the end of 2014.  
  
The number of the properties developed or currently in development by Times Property in the economically developed cities of Guangzhou, Foshan, Zhuhai, Zhongshan, Qingyuan and Changsha now exceeds 50. Accordingly, more than 300,000 owners proudly count themselves among those for whom a high quality residence is a central part of a more fulfilling life.  
  
Times Property, now and always the "life stylist" of China's real-estate industry, carries forth its abiding principle of "love, commitment and creation" while pursuing its mission as a leading real-estate enterprise in China. Through the constant endeavor toward a newer, better expression of performance in design, implementation and service integrity, we help more people achieve the life to which they can look forward.  
  
时代地产，成立于1999年，中国房地产50强，中国财富500强，香港联合交易所上市企业（股票代码：01233.HK）。目前主营业务为住宅产品、商业配套、创意办公的开发及物业服务。截止2014年，总资产已超300亿元人民币。  
  
时代地产目前在广州、佛山、珠海、中山、清远以及长沙等经济发达城市已经和正在开发的楼盘达50余个，为近30万业主提供了高品质的生活居所。  
  
时代地产坚持“区域聚焦、客户聚焦、业务聚焦”的企业战略，秉承以人为本的设计理念，将生活与艺术完美结合，并积极推进全生产链条的工业化进程，不断提升产品品质；持续提供全周期的物业服务，竭力满足客户需求。  
  
作为地产界中的生活艺术家，时代地产将继续奉行“爱、专注、创造”的核心价值观，从品质到品位，从地产到超越地产，逐步发展成为中国最优秀的房地产企业，让更多人实现向往的生活。

Cardi B's impact on popular culture cannot be overstated. Through her music, fashion, and outspoken nature, she has become a symbol of empowerment and resilience. Cardi B serves as an inspiration to many, proving that dreams can be achieved, even in the face of adversity.  
  
In a short span of time, Cardi B has managed to make an indelible mark on the music industry, becoming a household name and earning numerous awards, including Grammy Awards, MTV Video Music Awards, and Billboard Music Awards. Publix Super Markets, headquartered in Lakeland, Florida, is the largest and fastest-growing employee-owned supermarket chain in the United States, having been founded in 1930. With over 200,000 associates, Publix has established itself as a leader in the grocery retail industry, known for its commitment to customer service, quality products, and community engagement. The supermarket chain operates in the grocery and retail sectors, offering a wide array of products including fresh produce, meats, dairy, bakery items, and household essentials, as well as a growing selection of organic and specialty items to meet diverse consumer preferences.  
  
As a privately-owned company, Publix maintains a strong financial position with no long-term debt, allowing for continued expansion and investment in its stores and workforce. The company has a reputation for avoiding layoffs, even in challenging economic times, which underscores its commitment to its associates and their well-being. Publix is also recognized for its dedication to environmental sustainability and community involvement, with numerous initiatives aimed at reducing waste, conserving energy, and supporting local charities.  
  
In addition to traditional grocery offerings, Publix leverages technology to enhance the shopping experience, including online ordering and delivery services, mobile apps, and self-checkout options. The company’s focus on diversity and inclusion has fostered a positive workplace culture, making Publix not only a great place to work but also a preferred shopping destination for millions of customers. Through its unwavering commitment to excellence, Publix continues to thrive in the competitive supermarket landscape while making a meaningful impact in the communities it serves.

About North University of China
-------------------------------

North University of China (NUC), located in the picturesque city of Taiyuan, Shanxi Province, is a distinguished multi-disciplinary institution with a rich history dating back to 1958. Originally established as the Taiyuan Institute of Machinery, it evolved into the North China Institute of Technology before adopting its current name in 2004. Spanning an impressive 170 hectares, NUC is surrounded by the natural beauty of green mountains and a serene river, providing an inspiring environment for academic pursuit.  
  
NUC comprises 13 schools and offers a comprehensive range of academic programs, including 26 PhD programs, 82 Master’s programs, and 62 Bachelor’s programs, all authorized by the Academic Degrees Committee of the State Council. With a full-time enrollment of approximately 28,000 students, including 3,000 Ph.D. and Master candidates, NUC is dedicated to fostering a vibrant academic community. The university boasts over 2,385 staff members, including five esteemed academicians from the Chinese Academy of Engineering, ensuring a high caliber of education and research.  
  
The institution is recognized for its robust research capabilities, featuring 16 key disciplines and numerous state, provincial, and ministerial laboratories and research centers, including the NUC National Science Park. Since 2006, NUC has successfully undertaken over 3,800 research projects, securing a substantial funding of 2.4 billion Yuan RMB for scientific research and technological development. The university has garnered significant accolades, including five Second Prizes of the National Award for Science & Technology and 108 Provincial Awards for Science & Technology, underscoring its commitment to excellence in research and innovation.  
  
For those interested in the academic staff, the North University of China teachers list is available on their official website, showcasing the diverse expertise and qualifications of the faculty dedicated to nurturing the next generation of leaders and innovators.

About Huntsman Marine Science Centre
------------------------------------

The Huntsman Marine Science Centre (Huntsman) is a registered, private, not-for-profit research and science-based teaching institution located in St. Andrews, New Brunswick. The Huntsman was established in 1969 by a consortium of universities, government departments and private sector interests. The Huntsman has been an active steward of the ocean resource by finding ways to educate citizens about the oceans for the past 40 years. The education programs of the Huntsman have been pioneering; knowledge-based activities that have influenced the development of highly qualified personnel in the marine sciences and the oceans industry sector of the Canadian economy. The hands-on school programs have engaged over 35,000 students - ranging from elementary school age to university graduate level. For many, it is their first introduction to the Canadian Atlantic region. The Huntsman has also welcomed over 700,000 members of the general public through the operation of its aquarium facility, informing visitors to the region about Canada's east coast marine ecology and the marine based economy. The new Fundy Discovery Aquarium opened on September 1, 2011. The Huntsman Marine Science Centre is governed by a Board of Directors and has an Advisory Board. The campus is located in St. Andrews-by-the-Sea, New Brunswick, Canada which is on the shore of the St. Croix estuary, on the lower part of the Bay of Fundy.

Take in the fresh ocean air as you dine at one of the many local restaurants or tour museums and galleries on Abbot Kinney Boulevard. Whatever your mood or desire the Venice Beach area has something special for everyone.

Through relentless determination, research, pilot projects and campaigning, Theirworld is at the forefront of testing and shaping new ideas to help give children in the United Kingdom and around the world the best possible start in life. We never settle for the small wins and always reach for the highest hanging fruit, to ensure our work is impactful and life changing.  
  
Together, we are helping children and young people to unlock their potential by focussing our efforts on three causes:  
\- Giving every child the best start in life  
\- Every child has the right to go to school and learn  
\- Every young adult has access to skills development  
  
Across all our causes, our commitment is to the most marginalised children and young people, especially those caught up in conflicts and emergencies or discriminated against.  
  
Theirworld understands the power of bringing groups of passionate, influential people together - the whole is greater than the sum of its parts. The most effective and enduring impact comes from the collaborative and uniting efforts, and nothing can be solved in isolation.  
  
Theirworld works to unlock the solutions needed, making the seemingly impossible probable and helping every child have their best possible start in life. Only with the next generation of thinking, partnership and youth will we collectively overcome the obstacles facing today's children and young people.

About Henrik Kniberg

Henrik Kniberg is a man of many talents and titles. As the Chief Scientist and Co-founder of Hups.com, he is deeply immersed in the world of artificial intelligence, making him an "AI whisperer" of sorts. With a keen understanding of AI and its potential to revolutionize industries, Henrik is at the forefront of innovation in this rapidly evolving field. His expertise and insight make him an invaluable resource for companies looking to harness the power of AI in their products and services.  
  
In addition to his work at Hups.com, Henrik is also a co-founder of GoClimate.com, a platform dedicated to addressing the urgent issue of climate change. Through GoClimate, Henrik and his team are on a mission to empower individuals and organizations to take meaningful action to reduce their carbon footprint and combat global warming. As sustainability becomes an increasingly pressing concern, Henrik's work at GoClimate is both timely and crucial.  
  
As if that weren't impressive enough, Henrik also serves as an advisor for Teemyco, a company that specializes in digital collaboration and team management. With his extensive experience in the tech industry, Henrik is well-equipped to provide valuable guidance and strategic insight to help Teemyco achieve its goals and drive innovation in the workplace.  
  
But Henrik's contributions to the tech world don't stop there. He also serves as a consultant for Crisp, a leading consulting firm that specializes in agile software development and lean business practices. With his extensive knowledge and hands-on experience, Henrik is a valuable asset to the Crisp team, helping companies to streamline their operations and maximize their potential for success.  
  
Prior to his current roles, Henrik has left his mark on some of the most iconic companies in the world. As a former coach at Spotify, he played a pivotal role in shaping the company's agile development practices and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. His time at LEGO saw him applying his expertise to drive innovation and create compelling experiences for LEGO fans worldwide. And as a developer at Mojang, he played a key role in shaping the world of Minecraft, one of the most beloved and influential games of all time.  
  
Despite his impressive resume and myriad of responsibilities, Henrik remains refreshingly down-to-earth and approachable. He describes himself as someone who "likes to jam," indicating a laid-back and open-minded approach to life and work. This relaxed attitude, combined with his passion for technology and sustainability, makes Henrik an inspiring figure in the tech world.  
  
In summary, Henrik Kniberg is a multifaceted individual with a remarkable track record of success in the tech industry. As an AI whisperer and chief scientist at Hups.com, co-founder of GoClimate.com, advisor for Teemyco, and consultant for Crisp, he is deeply invested in driving innovation and positive change in the world. His diverse experiences at Spotify, LEGO, and Mojang have given him a unique perspective and a wealth of knowledge that continues to shape his work. With his down-to-earth nature and passion for making a difference, Henrik Kniberg is a force to be reckoned with in the tech world.
